5969.title: EHAM Schiphol Apron lighting
5969.body:
EHAM Schiphol Apron lighting - Airports for MSFS | Flightsim.to (https://flightsim.to/addon/5969/eham-schiphol-apron-lighting)
citeturn76search3 [wordlim: 200] Published: 5.7 years ago; Crawled: last week; Please check out this mod as a substitute: https://flightsim.to/file/28881/eham-lights-mod ... The scenery was made with the Standard version of Microsoft Flight Simulator 2020.

### Description

Important message:

Sadly in the latest Sim updates compatibility broke with Taxiway Q. Please check out this mod as a substitute: https://flightsim.to/file/28881/eham-lights-mod

I lost the files for for this mod, so I can not change it. If there is enough demand I could make an extra dependency to fix Taxiway Q, but this will be a seperate mod. Please leave a comment if interested.

This scenery only applies extra lighting to the buildings of Schiphol Airport.
I was a little dissapointed in myself that I didn't buy the Premium version of the game that includes a hand-crafter version of the airport. Sadly there are no third-party airports for Schiphol yet, so I need to ease the pain a little bit for myself.
To make arriving to the gate a little easier and less dark I decided to place some lights around the airport. These are divided in 2 categories:
Pier lighting:
Due to a lack of assets in the game for lighting on buildings there is 1 big mast at each gate. These are all placed related to the heading of the gate.

Apron lighting:
All apron lighting is placed based on GPS coördinates. I used all the correct masts as far as I could identify on the aerial photography
Please note:
The scenery was made with the Standard version of Microsoft Flight Simulator 2020. It is possible that lights are not correctly placed in the Deluxe and Premium versions of the game, as they are hand-crafted by Asobo

### Description

Welcome to StaticSceneries! This is an enhancement for the payware Heathrow airport by Inibuilds.

This airport can be found here: https://inibuilds.com/products/inibuilds-london-heathrow-egll-msfs

This scenery uses FSLTL models to enhance the airport and make it feel more lively without running FSLTL Injector. Please note: This is a standalone enhancement; if you run FSLTL injector at the same time you will see overlapping models. In-sim traffic must be turned off (Options/General Options/Traffic/Ground Aircraft Density slider to 0).

You must have the FSLTL Base models to use this!

There is no FPS loss with this whatsoever, as it only uses the models.

These models are static and will not move around. Some of the gates are unusable due to the placement of these aircraft.

 

HOW TO INSTALL:

 

Just open the downloaded folder, drop the folder within it named 'zzzSS-EGLL-StaticFSLTL' into your community folder and have a safe flight!

Please be aware that if you have EGLL FSLTL Static Aircraft by SavageSceneries installed, you will see overlapping aircraft. Use either one, but not both.

### Description

The Channel Islands are now repaired, at least my version didn't twitch, so this is now an airport and scenery upgrade. 

I've removed all of my elevations and adjusted the runway heights to fit the new version of the islands. 

You get four airports and a separate scenery file.

EGJJ Jersey. Some buildings have been replaced. There's a custom control tower. New ground markings. New ground textures. Plenty of extra detail scattered about such as fencing and car parks and a replaced taxi system. 

EGJB Guernsey. Given a thorough working over with custom buildings and improved ground markings and details. 

EGJA Alderney. A full set of custom buildings courtesy of Skell300  https://flightsim.to/profile/skell300  plus a new taxi system and all of the gubbins replaced. 

ZEGBQ Brecqhou which is not in the sim originally. This is just across from Sark where the evil Barclay brother lurks. Or probably doesn't any more. You get a 150 metre runway that lands next to his castle to annoy him. You also get two helipads and a floatplane parking space because you are a player.  

Scenery File  A separate scenery file that covers the islands. This adds static boats, removing some trees in the most offensive places, some lighthouses and the odd other detail. Nothing too radical. 

The second separate download Contains various tweaks to the scenery file for those have the Seafront Simulations mods or and the Alderney one by Inibuilds to replace the main version. All are included in the same download so delete whatever you don't need. 

V 3.3

Combines the previous two scenery files into one, so delete those completely if you have them. You may as well delete and replace the airports too as they're pretty old now. 

I've also combined the alternate scenery versions for Seafront Simluations/ Alderney owners into a separate download that you choose your version from, so throw away the scenery file that arrives with the main download and replace it with one of those. 

 

The scenery file adds moving and static boats for which you'll need these libraries - https://flightsim.to/file/27908/moving-boats-3d-model-library      https://flightsim.to/file/27907/static-boat-3d-model-library

citeturn92search0 [wordlim: 200] Published: 5.6 years ago; Crawled: 2 weeks ago; Adds some optional items from this https://flightsim.to/file/23692/superspud-airport-asset-library ... Upgrade your flight sim experience with the EGNS Ronaldsway Airport on the Isle of Man. ... Get ready to explore this enhanced airport scenery!
### Description

This is an upgrade of EGNS Ronaldsway Airport on the Isle of Man. 
If you haven't been here you jolly well should. Three things I very much enjoy are road racing, rallying and cutting that pesky tax bill. This place has all three in spades.
This wasn't tooo bad compared to other stock airports but I still felt like interfering with it. It was a wrench killing off the magnificant golden structure to the right of the terminal that looked like something Prince would've lived in, or emerged from on stage, but progress demanded it. 
All the ground textures and paint have been binned and replaced. The correct taxi system with taxiways and parking spaces has been installed. Light has been smeared all over. Outlying areas such as car parks, the fire station section and weird stretches of waste ground have been filled out. The airport approach has had some rock embedded in it. 
A particular highlight is the custom terminal designed by Ted Andrews. You may thank Skell300  https://flightsim.to/profile/skell300 for finding it, refining it and doing the textures to work in this. It definitely ties it up very nicely. Hopefully more custom buildings will pop along. 
One thing I couldn't solve is this area's fondness for turning luminous green. It's been like that for a long time so go hassle Asobo rather than me. 
V 1.4

Adds the Jet Centre as a startable hangar. 

Adds some optional items from this https://flightsim.to/file/23692/superspud-airport-asset-library

Clears up a few mistakes such as missing hold short lines and a car that has been sitting on the apron like a lonely turd at sunset for months. Whoops. 

Sorts out some night lighting and cloudy glass.

The Miami Executive Airport, formerly known until 2014 as Kendall-Tamiami Executive Airport (ICAO: KTMB) is a public airport in Miami-Dade County, Florida, 13 miles (21 km) southwest of Downtown Miami. It is operated by the Miami-Dade Aviation Department.

The airport opened on November 18, 1967, replacing Tamiami Airport, next to the Tamiami Trail. Growth of the surrounding area and the nearby flight path to Miami International Airport forced the move to the southwest, near the community of Kendall. The Florida International University is now on the site of the old Tamiami Airport. ## A standalone 2024 version is now available from the fine button below the main download.

 

This be EKVG - Vagar airport in the Faroe Islands. 

A very cool video trailer here courtesy of Finite Flying - https://youtu.be/v1or42XikGY

A fine place to stop off for your transatlantic hopping. After an eternity this is officially in the sim so this is now an upgrade of the existing site. 

All ground textures disposed of. New ground markings added. Fencing all over. Light applied where it counts. Detail aplenty thrown down.

This has a new taxi system. There are two helicopter parking spots - 100 and 101. There is also a hangar start inside the Atlantic Airways hangar which is space number 6. 

On the main apron spaces 3-5 are large GA with a full set of ground services. There's also all the fuel you can scoff. 

You may thank Simon Nordendal of Azurafiles for very generously granting permission to use the Vagar custom buildings he made for his payware versions for FSX and P3D.

### Description

Nuuk Airport (Greenlandic: Mittarfik Nuuk), also called Nuuk International Airport (IATA: GOH, ICAO: BGGH), is the airport of the capital of Greenland, Nuuk, Denmark. The airport is home to Greenland's flag carrier, Air Greenland. Its runway is oriented 22-04 and is 2,200 metres long. It is at an altitude of 283 feet. This airport, like all Greenland airports, is run by Mittarfeqarfiit, the airport authority of Greenland. In 2008 it served 63,575 passengers. With a connection to Keflavik with Air Iceland and Air Greenland (this route was inaugurated with the purchase of the new Dash 8 Q100, to replace the old Dash 7) it is one of the six international Greenlandic airports.

I'd like to share with the community the enhancement pack for freeware scenery of Iqaluit Airport (CYFB) by Asobo. The Team made fantastic scenery, but there are a few things that are missing from the scenery, therefore this enhancement pack will add the missing details. 

NOTAM

This enhancement pack does not change nor modify the original scenery in any way. It only adds small details to make it even better.

NOTAM #2

This airport can be further enhanced by adding Christmas decorations available here

Elements added:

### Description

I am happy to present to community the enhancement pack for jpfil's freeware Kuujjuaq Airport (CYVP) available here: https://www.jpfil.com/quebec-fs2020/aeroports.htm

NOTAM

This enhancement pack does not change nor modify the original scenery in any way. It only adds a lot of stuff to make it even better.

I used recordings from lantings/take off/spotting and google maps as well as screens from old X-Plane and FSX sceneries as a reference for placing objects and setting gates directions.

The original airport is a good starting point, but it's missing few things here and there, so I decided to enhance it a little bit. What you will find in this enhancement pack is:

- Airport illumination

- Whole interior of the terminal done with people waiting, departure/arrival screens, small playground for children, baggage carousel etc. The interior is not exact representation of the real-life thing, but I tried to keep it as close to reality as I could.

- New car park in front of the airport

- Telephone masts around airport

- A bit of terraforming to get the scenery in line with surrounding land

- Nearby fuel tanks and construction site (?) done

- Airport fencing

- Few hazard lights

- Clutter around airport

- Few gates added - when starting at teh airport make sure you start at: Gate 1 (twin otter/ dash8, King Air), Gate 2 (Boeing 737-2/5/600/7), Gate 3 (twin otter/ dash8, King Air), Gate 4 (Boeing 737-2/5/600/7/8),  Gate 5 (twin otter/ dash8, King Air)

- Few lines leading to gates (fictional, just to help with taxing)

Most objects this time come from default MSFS SDK libraries, but a few additional are needed:

- ALL world updates and associated airports

- https://flightsim.to/file/16674/we-love-vfr-region-2

- https://www.jpfil.com/quebec-fs2020/collections.htm (that's a library, which jpfil uses in all his airports)

- https://flightsim.to/file/8824/emerald-object-library (available also via marketplace)

- UK2000 freeware library (available via marketplace

- https://flightsim.to/file/5452/dave-s-3d-people-library

- https://flightsim.to/file/33166/animated-humans-library

- https://flightsim.to/file/4696/dave-s-crooked-library

- EDHK Lights & Objects Developers Pack (Asset-Pack) - https://flightsim.to/file/2549/edhk-lights-pack

- https://flightsim.to/file/16007/msfs-object-library-with-150-models-ranging-from-towers-hangers-terminals-to-cones

- Superspud library https://flightsim.to/file/23692/superspud-airport-asset-library

- Aerosoft's EDLP paderborn (freeware available via Aerosoft One app)

A PLEA

- If you see a problem, if something's not working, DO LET ME KNOW either in comments section of via private message. I can't fix the problem if I don't know about its existence.

If you're seeing something weird, but you're not using this enhancement with the airport it's designed for, don't report it.

- Follow the file. It's not for me, but for you. If the file is corrupt for some reason, or causes CTD, IT WILL be updated. If you don't follow the file, you will miss the updates and might be stuck with either incomplete or corrupt version.

### Description

Saint-Pierre Pointe-Blanche Airport[1] (French: Aéroport de Saint-Pierre Pointe-Blanche or Saint Pierre Pointe-Blanche Airport) (IATA: FSP, ICAO: LFVP)[2] is a regional airport located 1 nautical mile (1.9 km; 1.2 mi) south of Saint-Pierre, in the overseas collectivity (collectivité d'outre-mer) of Saint-Pierre and Miquelon, off the east coast of Canada, near Newfoundland. ### Description

Override the terrain of KJFK airport released by inibuilds to flatten it out and remove the bumps.

The three runways other than 4R/22L seemed too white, so a texture was added to darken them slightly.

IF YOU NO LONGER HAVE CRASH-TO-DESTOP ERRORS WHEN YOU LOAD MY SCENERY SINCE ALL THE RECENT SIM UPDATES, PLEASE LET ME KNOW. I PREVIOUSLY UPLOADED A 'LITE VERSION' AT THE FOLLOWING LINK BELOW SOME TIME IN 2021 TO CORRECT THAT, HOWEVER IT IS NOT UPDATED TO V1.5 AND I WOULD LIKE TO REMOVE IT:

DEPENDENCIES:

NEW LIGHTING EFFECTS AND ITEMS ADDED: In order to see some of the new lighting effects, additional sail boats and some 3d people used in this scenery, you will need to download and save in your community folder some required files. Check "Dependencies" section for link to download.

 

DESCRIPTION:

                                The Cyril E. King Airport is the largest international airport in the U.S. Virgin Islands and one of the busiest hubs in the eastern Caribbean. The Airport is a public airport located at No. 70 Lindbergh Bay on the southwestern side of St. Thomas, U.S. Virgin Islands - approximately four miles east of the capital city, Charlotte Amalie.  South-West of Beef Island, Tortola and North of St. Criox. It's one of the busiest airports in the eastern Caribbean. Many direct flights are available for international travelers arriving from the U.S., with non-stop service to St. Thomas from Atlanta, Boston, Chicago, Dulles, Fort Lauderdale, Miami, Newark, and New York. It was known as Harry S Truman Airport until 1984, when it was renamed to honor Cyril Emmanuel King, the second elected governor of the U.S. Virgin Islands. A new airport opened in November 1990 and retained the name.

                               This is my first US based airport i've done, so obviously there were some differences to this than with previous airports while constructing and putting this scenery together. I put most of the effort in the layer of ground texturing and the variety of object details especially for the main terminal parking area as much as I could to make this look at least 90% accurate.

                                While almost completing this, I learned there was a payware version to this out. If I had knew about it before, I wouldn't have taken up the task of doing this, but I continued on anyways since I reached that far. I do hope you will enjoy regardless!

 

 

 INSTALLATION:

Open and extract ''lexpro-St Thomas_updated_scenery_project_v1.0'' (or the version name you choose to download) to your prefered location on your PC, then unZip and open the folder and copy  "Cyril_E_King_Updated_Scenery_Project" folder into where your Community folder is located, then start the sim and go to TIST - Cyril E. King Airport. That's it!

Each time I upload an updated version here, just replace the same "Cyril_E_King_Updated_Scenery_Project"  folder in your Community folder to update the scenery. Make back ups to the old folders if necessary. 

 

DETAILED UPDATED FEATURES TO DEFAULT SCENERY (V1.0) - TIST:

 

  * - Started from scratch and deleted everything except the default terminal building and a few surrounding buildings.
  * - Stratigically placed very specific scenery objects from the sim library around the default building to try match the design structure IRL.
  * - Made some corrections to the surrounding terrain and elevation of the Airport. A bit challenging but managable in the end.
  * -  Added runway/lights, PAPI lights, aprons, taxi lights [despite the fact that by default they were already there, editing the elevation made them dissapear, so I had to replace them again :\ ], taxi ways, taxiway signs,[A few might not be too accurate] ''wear n' tear'' textures, ground markings and a couple dark painted color lines exactly like IRL.
  * - Edited airport taxiway data so ATC properly directs you to and from your parking location. 
  * Added and created heavily detailed 'wear n' tear' and layered textures to main apron of terminal building as well as some extra layered textures to taxiways to give a more 'used' feel.
Also lighting on a few boats, yachts and a cruiseship. [Remember to check Dependencies for required files to see them]
  * - Added static aircraft\service vehicles with some animated Marshalls\Workers surrounding them.
  * - Randomly placed Marshalls/Workers and other animated people around the Airport in general. [Some of these are additional 3d people. Again, check Dependencies section to see them]
  * - Added barbwire fencing around parts of the Airport like IRL. Also added additional fencing in certain areas within the airport.

Tortola is the largest and most populated of the British Virgin Islands, a group of islands that form part of the archipelago of the Virgin Islands. ### Description

#### CLAYTON J. L LOYD INTERNATIONAL AIRPORT UPDATED SCENERY PROJECT 

 

 

 

DESCRIPTION:

This is a custom scenery update to the airport on the island of Anguilla. It is located North of St. Maarten. Formerly known as Wallblake International. a British Overseas Territory in the Caribbean. The airport is located very close to The Valley, the island's capital. The airport became known as the "Clayton J. Lloyd International Airport" on 4 July 2010. Its namesake was the first Anguillan aviator and founded the first Anguillan air service, Air Anguilla, which was later renamed Valley Air Service. The island is known for its very low (flat) formation and very white sandy beaches.

For me, this airport was a bit challening to research properly due to the many changes it went through from 2012 up until 2020, and because of the pandemic there were hardly any videos to source from for up to date scenery until recently. So I kept changing and correcting stuff at the last minute. (lol)

 

INSTALLATION:

Open and extract ''lexpro-Anguilla_updated_scenery_project_v1.0.zip'' (or the version name you choose to download) to your prefered location on your PC, then unZip and open the folder and copy "Clayton J. Lloyd-International_Updated_Scenery_Project" folder into where your Community folder is located, then start the sim and go to TQPF Wallblake International (still has the old name). That's it!

Each time I upload an updated version here, just replace the same "Clayton J. Lloyd-International_Updated_Scenery_Project"  folder in your Community folder to update the scenery. Make back ups to the old folders if necessary. 

 

DETAILED UPDATED FEATURES TO DEFAULT SCENERY (V1.0) -:

  * - Started from scratch and deleted everything except the default terminal building.
  * - Stratigically placed very specific scenery objects from the sim library around the default building to try match the design structure IRL.
  * - Made some corrections to the surrounding terrain of the Airport  
  * -  Added runway/lights, PAPI lights, aprons, taxi lights, taxi ways, ''wear n' tear'' textures and ground markings. 
  * - Corrected location of Windsocks
  * - Added a light above the Windsocks
  * - Added the control tower with a beacon light [This time I had to add a beacon light to the default tower that had a built-in beacon attached beacause it wasn't emitting itself. I have no idea why. I still left it inserted it inside the default tower though.]
  * - Added a second smaller control tower near by to simulate the old tower they have been using during renovations before moving to the large one.
  * - Added Airport lights around the airport to give it some life at night.
  * -  Added extra lighting under the Airport terminal roofings that was added. Also extra lighting on specific buildings around the airport.
  * - Added static aircraft\service vehicles with some animated Marshalls\Workers surrounding them.
  * - Randomly placed Marshalls/Workers and other animated people around the Airport in general.
  * - Added barbwire fencing around entire Airport. [Some parts may not be too accurate]
  * - Added red lights on top of each tall airport light, control tower and the anntena positioned in between taxiway A and B [There is a possibility that not everyone can see these. Let me know] 
  * - Added many more trees/plants/grass, auto-gen trees in general areas close to and surrounding the Airport.  
  * Added a couple aircrafts to the south side of the airport to depict either old aircraft or where they keep them for maintenance purposes. Also replaced 2 warehouses where they park the planes.
  * - Added street lights to light up the roads close by and the roads surrounding the airport.
  * - Added many different objects and items to populate the scenery in detail.
  * - Added 2 animated flags and 1 static where actual flags are supposed to be [May not be too accurate]
  * - Added the parking lots with vehicles to the North of the terminal building as well as other scattered scenery objects around the airport in general. [Work in progress]
 
Thats all for now. More to come in every version update. Do enjoy this on going project which takes a great deal of time and effort. Feel free to leave any comments after you've flown around. Have fun flying and see you in the Sim world :)

### Description

This is an upgrade of the area around St Barts airport and also includes a fix for the overbearing trees on the approach that ruin your showboating landings. 

You may thank - https://flightsim.to/profile/mamu82  for figuring out how to do this. I wouldn't have had a sodding clue. 

At the moment it's pretty crude but gets the job done. Asobo did improve the original version but it's still too much so this is still valid. 

 

Elsewhere this builds on top of the Asobo TFFJ so you need to keep that installed. 

The ground textures have been replaced. The ground markings have been improved and the terminal has been given an interior. A new taxi system has been glued in to better reflect reality along with helipads. 

Also fitted to the terminal are opening doors for a GSX profile by ElevateSolutions available here - https://flightsim.to/file/62650/tffj-gustaf-iii-airport-st-barts-gsx-profile-superspud-freeware

What I couldn't manage is to improve the elevations. Terraforming would not play ball. I have adjusted the runway profile to be a bit closer to reality but it's not perfect and is simply a bit wavy rather than a nice curve downwards. 


Elsewhere I've populated the harbour with some boats and added roads and detail to the harbour area

 

Since there are so many other mods in this area I've now split this into multiple packages, so pick what you want from the main download zip file and get rid of the rest. 

tffj-stbarts-upgrade -  This is the upgrade to the airport. It also includes the roads and road markings elsewhere. This now doesn't have the tree fix. 

tffj-stbartsfix-only -  This is just the tree fix for the runway approach if that's all you want. 

tffj-stbarts-boats - This populates the main harbour and elsewhere with boats and adds moving boats to the area too. One landable superyacht is chugging away out to sea. 

tffj-static-planes - Adds a few extra static planes to the airport to increase excitement. 

tffj-tff1-stbarts-seaplaneairport - A seaplane airport with three parking spots in the harbour. ICAO - TFF1. There is also a helipad on a superyacht out to sea.  

V 1.6

Addresses the new boat burns in from the latest world update as there are many more of them. 

Improves taxi signage as the originals are awfully bulky. 

Repairs the broken flags that weren't behaving. 

Tweaks the seaplane base around the newly moved boats.

### Description

#### R. L. BRADSHAW INTERNATIONAL & VANCE W. AMORY INTERNATIONAL AIRPORT UPDATED SCENERY PACK PROJECT 

[WORK IN PROGRESS]

DESCRIPTION:

This is a scenery combo pack project for the R. L. Bradshaw International and Vance W. Amory International Airports on the Islands of St. Kitts & Nevis located in the Caribbean North-West of Antigua. Being a local on the Island of St. Kitts and a frequent Sim flyer since 2002 and after flying around in the default scenery for MSFS2020, I decided to take up the task of using/learning Developer Mode and update the Airport scenery and its surroundings close to IRL.

It's still a work in progress here and there.  I'm still sorting out any bug/terrain formation issues I get from time to time after compiling. It's not perfect and I'm not 100% accurate but I try for at least 95%. :)

I've updated Nevis (TKPN - Vance W. Amory International Airport) as well after reaching some good headway with St.Kitts (TKPK). Though, still a work in progress as TKPN's parking lot behind has yet to be completed.

If anyone who downloads these (specifically locals like myself who are frequent flight simmers or real life pilots who know the islands well) have any issues/comments/suggestions on how/where certain things are placed (or missing) feel free to connect with me here. I'm open to any suggestions to anything I may have missed while doing this project.

INSTALLATION:

For previous users who downloaded earlier versions of this mod before v2.0, I recommend deleting the entire old folder from your Community folder before installing this version as to prevent seeing double objects in the scenery. This version now includes Nevis and thus the folder name had to be changed.

Open and extract ''lexpro-tkpk_tkpn-updated-scenery-pack-project-v2.5.0zip'' (or the version name you choose to download) to your prefered location on your PC, then unZip and open the folder and copy both "R L Bradshaw Int_Updated_Scenery_Project" and "Vance W Amory Int_Updated_Scenery_Project" folders into where your Community folder is located, then start the sim and go to TKPK Bradshaw International or TKPN Vance Amory International. That's it!

Each time I upload an updated version here, just replace the same "R L Bradshaw Int_Updated_Scenery_Project" folder or "Vance W Amory Int_Updated_Scenery_Project" folder in your Community folder to update the scenery. Make back ups to the old folders if necessary. 

(Please note, when choosing a parking space for departure, don't choose any single digit parking spaces numbered by themselves. Those are for the service vehicles to drive to if you have them enabled in your settings. You will be spawned in locations not meant for Airplanes. This is also the only way I found to manipulate these vehicles from annoyingly taxi on the same taxiway as the player but unforunately still park in your parking space)

DETAILED UPDATED FEATURES TO DEFAULT SCENERY (V2.5) - TKPN:

                                          [COMING SOON]

 

DETAILED UPDATED FEATURES TO DEFAULT SCENERY (V2.5) - TKPK:

  * - Updated and corrected taxiway markings and data for all aprons to how they look IRL [present day]
  * - Updated taxiway Alpha textures to a concrete look [IRL they recently repaved taxiway Alpha]
  * - Corrected terraforming and elevation for taxiway Alpha [IRL it's not completely flat and not on the same level as the runway]
  * - Corrected actual position of windsock
  * - Added extra anntenas where they are located IRL
  * - Added an extra row of PAPI lights [IRL there are 2 different sets of the lights. My guess is that they upgraded them and left the old ones behind the new ones.]
  * - Added some additional scenery details here and there.
  * - Added the words "Welcome to SKB" in the middle of the solar panels like they are IRL.
  * - Added back taxiway lights that were removed because of previous sim/world updates.
  * - Corrected threshold markings for Runway 07/25 to present day look.
  * -  Added a building and a few scenery objects together that simulates where our covid-19 testing station is presently on the main apron
DETAILED UPDATED FEATURES TO DEFAULT SCENERY (V1.0) - TKPN:

  * - Started from scratch and deleted everything except the default terminal building.
  * - I havn't used Blender in very long while, so I stratigically placed very specific scenery objects from the sim library around the default building to try match the design structure IRL.
  * - Made some corrections to the surrounding terrain of the Airport [This was somewhat challenging to get it right] 
  * -  Added runway/lights, PAPI lights, aprons, taxi lights, taxi ways, ''wear n' tear'' textures and ground markings. [The parking names/letters may not be accurate so I just used my imagination]
  * -  Corrected location of Windsock
  * - Added a light above the Windsock
  * - Added the control tower with a beacon light [Had to use another default tower that had a built-in beacon attached and inserted it inside this one as the one I added from the sim was not showing for some reason?]
  * - Added Airport lights around the airport to give it some life at night.
  * -  Added extra lighting under and above the Airport terminal roofing that was added and around the sides.
  * - Added static aircraft\service vehicles with some animated Marshalls surrounding them.
  * - Randomly placed Marshalls and other animated people around the Airport in general.
  * - Added barbwire fencing around entire Airport, including a concrete wall that's South of the control tower that's literally built from a single brick :)
  * -  Added many more trees/plants/grass, auto-gen trees in general areas close to and surrounding the Airport
  * - Added 1 boat where they are usually located at by the dock. [Work in progress]
  * - Added street lights to light up the road and additional lamp posts with lights along the Northern side of the runway.
  * - Added the approach red lights behind runway 10
  * - Cleared default parking lot behind terminal building to recontruct it [work in progress]
DETAILED UPDATED FEATURES TO DEFAULT SCENERY (V1.0) - TKPK:

  * - Started from scratch and deleted everything except the default terminal building.
  * - Still havn't used Blender in very long while, so I stratigically placed very specific scenery objects from the sim library around the default building to try and match the design structure IRL :)
  * - Made some corrections to the surrounding terrain of the Airport and raised "Booby Island". MSFS had it flat by default  (The extremely tiny island in the channel between St.Kitts and Nevis) 
  * - Added runway/lights, PAPI lights, aprons, taxi lights, taxi signs, taxi ways, textures and ground markings. (The parking names/letters and taxi sign letters may not be accurate so I just used my imagination)
  * - Corrected location of Windsock and added the small red and white checkered building next to it
  * - Added the control tower with a beacon light (Had to use another default tower that had a built-in beacon attached and inserted it inside this one as the one I added from the sim was not showing for some reason?]
  * -Added the Airport's solar panels near the runway and removed the auto generated buildings that were in their place. 
  * - Replaced the default building they had as the hanger which is normally on the East apron with one thats close enough to the real thing (in shape and color that is)
  * - Added Airport lights around the airport to give it some life at night.
  * - Added extra lighting under the Airport terminal roofing that was added
  * - Added static aircraft\service vehicles with some animated Marshalls surrounding them.
  * - Randomly placed Marshalls and other animated people around the Airport in general. (Take the drone and have a look around if you like :-] )
  * - Added barbwire fencing around entire Airport  (and the section of land behind Runway 07)
  * - Added many scenery objects/details/markings to the Airport parking lot to match close to IRL as possible (work in progress)
  * - Added many more trees/plants in general areas close to the Airport
  * - Added cruiseships, boats and docks where they are usually located at sea.
  * - Added tall lights to both Cricket stadiums
  * - Added street lights to light up the Bypass road and Kim Collins Highway and additional lamp posts along the road
  * - Added paved roads to the Bypass road and Kim Collins Highway and some near the Airport (work in progress)
  * - Added extra animated traffic on the bypass road to give it some life. (By default the sim has the US standard traffic rules and not Europe standards which we do adapt IRL) I may add some more later on in areas that are usually busy
  * -Added traffic lights in their current locations around Basseterre (Again, fly around with the drone if you'd like to see them.)
  * - Added the approach red lights behind runway 07 and additional scenery objects to replicate the real life scenery behind there
  * - Added an animated flag where our national flag pole is supposed to be (I'm not sure if everyone can see this or if it's a default in the library. Anyone who can't see it let me know right away)

 

Thats all for now. More to come in every version update here. Do enjoy this on going project which took a great deal of time and effort. Feel free to leave any comments after you've flown around. Have fun flying and see you in the Sim world :)

# R. L. Bradshaw Int.(TKPK) & Vance Amory Int.(TKPN) Updated Scenery Pack Project 2.5

This is a scenery combo pack project for the R. L. Bradshaw International and Vance W. Amory International Airports on the Islands of St. Kitts & Nevis located in the Caribbean North-West of Antigua. Being a local on the Island of St. Kitts and a frequent Sim flyer since 2002 and after flying around in the default scenery for MSFS2020, I decided to take up the task of using/learning Developer Mode and update the Airport scenery and its surroundings close to IRL. It's still a work in progress here and there.  I'm still sorting out any bug/terrain formation issues I get from time to time after compiling. It's not perfect and I'm not 100% accurate but I try for at least 95%. :)

Pointe-à-Pitre International Airport or Pointe-à-Pitre Le Raizet Airport (French: Aérodrome de Pointe-à-Pitre Le Raizet or Aéroport Guadeloupe Pôle Caraïbes "Caribbean Hub"  is an international airport serving Pointe-à-Pitre on the island of Grande-Terre in Guadeloupe, France.

The airport is located in Abymes, 2.4 km (1.3 NM) north-northeast of Pointe-à-Pitre. It is the main hub for Air Caraïbes and Air Antilles Express. Air France also has two Airbus A320 based in Pointe-à-Pitre for regional flights. It is the largest of the six airports in the archipelago. In 2019, the airport handled 2,488,782 passengers; it is the second busiest airport in the Lesser Antilles after Queen Beatrix International Airport located in Aruba, and before Grantley Adams International Airport located in Barbados.

# Douglas-Charles (TDPD) & Canefield (TDCF) Airports Updated Scenery Project V1.5

Formerly known as Melville Hall International (TDPD), Douglas-Charles located on the East side of the island, is also well known as the airport with a challenging landing going into runway 09 due to the high mountainous terrain approach. At night, Runway 27 is Highly recommended and NOT Runway 09 which is why it's also known as one of the most interesting yet scenic and challlenging airports to land on. Canefield Airport (TDCF) is no exception to this as the small airport is on the West side of the island and due to the placement of the runway, pilots will almost always experience cross wind landings beacause of the near hilly terrain. Only skilled pilots are allowed to land on Runway 19. Runway 01 is either prohibited or rarely used for landing. For me, these two were fun airports to re-create in the sim :)

### Description

#### Hewanorra International (TLPL) & George F. L. Charles Airport (TLPC) Updated Scenery Pack Project

[UPDATED AS NEW INFO IS DISCOVERED]

 

 

#### DEPENDENCIES:

In order to see the static Airbus Helicopter in the Helicopter parking, download it from HypePerformanceGroup's page https://flightsim.to/file/8970/airbus-h135-helicopter-project and check out their discord at  https://discord.gg/dUNDGb2Z7c Those guys are awesome at what they do!   DESCRIPTION:

While doing this project, a payware version was released by FSDG. I think they did both airports as well. At the time i'd already completed about 75% of both airports, so I kept going with it. Check it out at Aerosofts website.

The island of Saint Lucia is located in the Caribbean, South of Martinique and North of Saint Vincent and the Grenadines and is part of the Winward islands. Hewanorra International Airport (TLPL), located near Vieux Fort Quarter, Saint Lucia, is the larger of Saint Lucia's two airports and is managed by the Saint Lucia Air and Seaports Authority (SLASPA). It is on the southern cape of the island, about 53.4 km (33.2 mi) from the capital city, Castries.

The airport can accommodate Boeing 747, Airbus A330, Airbus A340, Boeing 777, and other long-range intercontinental aircraft.

 

The country's smaller airport, George F. L. Charles Airport, (TLPC) is located in Castries and handles inter-Caribbean passenger flights, which are operated with turboprop and prop aircraft.

 

 

INSTALLATION:

Open and extract ''lexpro-St Lucia_updated_scenery_pack_project_v1.0'' (or the version name you choose to download) to your prefered location on your PC, then unZip and open the folder and copy both "George_F_L_Charles_Airport_Updated_Scenery_Project" and "Hewanorra_International_Airport_Updated_Scenery_Project" folders into where your Community folder is located, then start the sim and go to TLPL-Hewanorra International or TLPC-George F. L. Charles Airport. That's it!

Each time I upload an updated version here, just replace the same "George_F_L_Charles_Airport_Updated_Scenery_Project"  folder or "Hewanorra_International_Airport_Updated_Scenery_Project" folder in your Community folder to update the scenery. Make back ups to the old folders if necessary. 

 

DETAILED UPDATED FEATURES TO DEFAULT SCENERY (V1.0) - TLPL:

  * - Started from scratch and deleted everything except the default terminal building.
  * - Stratigically placed very specific scenery objects from the sim library around the default building to try match the design structure IRL. 
  * - Made some corrections to the surrounding terrain of the Airport which caused me to re-terraform the moutain East of the airport. 
  * -  Added runway/lights, PAPI lights, aprons, taxi lights, taxiway signs, taxi ways, ''wear n' tear'' textures and ground markings/numberings. 
  * - Programed ATC data to call out the designated taxiway path letters and gate numbers.
  * - Corrected location of Windsocks
  * - Added a light above the Windsocks
  * - Added the control tower with a beacon light
  * - Added Airport lights around the airport and also lights in the parking lot and around various areas surrounding the airport including nearby roads.
  * -  Added extra lighting under and around the Airport terminal roofing that was added and also on surrounding buildings in the area. 
  * - Added static aircraft\service vehicles surrounding the airport and in various areas, Including an Airbus H135 Helicopter I put in one of the heliport parking spaces which you'll have to download from HypePerformanceGroup's page to see it. [See Dependencies]
  * - Randomly placed Marshalls/Workers and other animated people around the Airport in general.
  * - Added barbwire fencing around entire Airport and in other surrounding areas. [work in progress]
  * - Added some animated\moving vehicles along the long stretched road South of the airport and in the parking lot.
  * - Added many more trees/plants/grass, auto-gen trees in general areas close to and surrounding the Airport. 
  * - Added many rows of solar panels along the North-Western side of the airport where there is supposed to be a solar panel farm IRL. [work in progress]
  * - Added the correct approach lights behind runway 10 for night landings
  * - Added the parking lot with vehicles to the North of the terminal building as well as other scattered scenery objects and items around the airport in general.

 

DETAILED UPDATED FEATURES TO DEFAULT SCENERY (V1.0) - TLPC:
 

  * - Started from scratch and deleted everything except the default terminal building.
  * - Stratigically placed very specific scenery objects from the sim library around the default building to try and match the design structure IRL
  * - Made some slight corrections to the surrounding terrain of the Airport which lead to re-terra-forming both the small moutain immediately North of Runway 09 and the mountain East of Runway 27. 
  * - Added runway/lights, aprons, taxi lights, taxi ways, taxiway signs, 'wear n tear' textures and ground markings/numberings.
  * - Programed ATC data to call out the designated taxiway path letters and gate numbers.
  * - Corrected location of Windsocks and added lights above them.
  * - Added the control tower with a beacon light on top of terminal building.
  * - Added Airport lights around the airport and extra lighting around the Airport terminal and other buildings in the area that was added. Also street lights on the nearby roads along side the airport
  * - Added some grass patches on the West side the terminal building
  * - Randomly placed a few Marshalls and other animated people around the Airport in general. 
  * - Added barbwire fencing around the Airport and some stone work at the end of Runway 09 like IRL
  * - Added many scenery objects and items on and around the airport in general
  * - Added animated/moving vehicles on the nearby roads along side the airport.
  * - Added some static aircrafts around the airport, including 2 Airbus H135 Helicopters I put close to the end of Runway 09 which you'll have to download from HypePerformanceGroup's page to see them. [See Dependencies]
 
Thats all for now. More to come in every version update. Do enjoy this on going project which takes a great deal of time and effort. Feel free to leave any comments after you've flown around. Have fun flying and see you in the Sim world :)

### Description

A. N. R. Robinson International Airport (formerly Crown Point International Airport) (IATA: TAB, ICAO: TTCP) is an international airport located on Crown Point, Tobago in Trinidad and Tobago. It is located in the southwesternmost part of the island, near the town of Canaan, and 11 km (6.8 mi) from the capital, Scarborough. It is one of two international airports serving the twin isle republic. The A. N. R. Robinson International Airport is situated on the southwestern tip of the island of Tobago. This airport is located within walking distance of some of several of the island's beaches. The airport was commissioned in December 1940 when the Work Department laid a 670-meter (2,200 ft) landing strip.

The facilities at Crown Point were upgraded in the mid-1980s to accommodate a new terminal building, access roads, and extended apron. Further developments were commenced in 1987 and completed in 1992 to accommodate wide-bodied aircraft such as the Boeing 747. Another development program was scheduled to commence in 2011, anticipated to include an extension of the terminal building, runway works and the addition of jet bridges to the structure.

TNCB Bonaire Kralendijk Flamingo Intl. airport version 0.1.80
by MSL FS-Creations
Location: Bonaire = 12.131863, -68.276817 (for Flightsim.to website scenery map)

The standard airport TNCB in MSFS2020 was not complete so I did some work on it to fix some things
This scenery is suitable for use with Internet ATC (like VATSIM or IVAO).
It includes the runway, parkings, taxiways, apron and some airport traffic vehicles.

In the package:
- All taxiways, gates and stands updated from standard MSFS2020
- Taxiway lights added / updated
- Nightlight at the aprons
- No fuel stand, I do not know where it is
- No Pushback truck at gate/stands 1, 1R, 2, 3, 4L and 4 (see also known issues below)
- Antenna for NDB PJB (321)
- Antenna for VOR PJB (115.00)
- Fiction: ILS for rwy 10 (108.100) (hidden, no visable objects)
- Fiction: Airport roads with airport traffic
- Fiction: Two tanker ships in the area
- Tested on MSFS2020 version v1.25.9.0

Not in the package but using the standards:
- ATC Communications
- NAV systems
- Buildings

Sources I used:
Geo: Google Earth
Airport design: ADE Alpha 21 HF5
Airport docs: Navigraph / Jeppesen

Installation:
Just place the folder "TNCB Kralendijk Flamingo Intl by MSL FS-Creations" into the community folder
If there is an other scenery for TNCB in the community folder, than it can give problems
Startup the sim and explore

Known issues:
- Stand arrow signs along the taxiways are in yellow instead of black, compiler issue
- The pushback trucks on gate/stands 1, 1R, 2, 3, 4L and 4 are still on the apron, compiler issue
- For example MSFS ATC will order you from stand 5 or 6 to taxi via E rwy 10 - D - C - rwy 10 - B - A for RWY 10 instead of only taxiway E and backtrack rwy 10. Just stop at de first holding and call tower for takeoff clearance

Have fun by flying at Bonaire - Dutch Caribbean

### Description

Frustrated by the lack of high-quality representations of SYCJ in the sim, I decided to take matters into my own hands. As a flight simmer born and raised in Suriname, I’ve always dreamed of seeing our region accurately represented. This project is my contribution to the community, ensuring Guyana’s primary gateway finally gets the attention it deserves. Expect future updates and let me know if something isn't working! I am happy to help out!
This airport was a challenge, because of lacking up-to-date aerial data.
SYCJ - Cheddi Jagan International Airport | Guyana

Welcome to the primary gateway of Guyana! Located in Timehri, approximately 25 miles south of the capital city, Georgetown, Cheddi Jagan International (SYCJ) is a critical hub connecting the Caribbean to South America.

Previously known as Timehri International, this airport has undergone a massive real-world transformation. From its origins as Atkinson Field during WWII to its current status as a modernized international terminal, SYCJ offers a unique approach over the Demerara River and the dense, lush rainforests of Guyana. The aiport is a frequent visitor of the boeing 737-8/800 and 787

### ✈️ Airport Features

  * Detailed Layout: Accurate taxiway, apron and runway configurations based on the latest charts.
  * The Main Strip: Runway 06/24—the primary 11,023ft asphalt runway
  * CUSTOM TERMINAL MODEL: Features the newly expanded terminal building and passenger boarding bridges.

### 🛠 Installation

  1. Download the ZIP file.
  2. Extract the folder into your MSFS Community folder.
  3. Restart your simulator and enjoy your flight to Guyana!
📦 Required Dependencies

To ensure all 3D objects, textures, and assets appear correctly, you must have the following installed:

    1. MSFS Object Library (By Colinj) – This is the standard library used for many of the custom hangars, towers, and airport props.

    2. World Update XIX: Brazil (Marketplace) – Please ensure you have downloaded the free World Update Brazil from the in-sim Marketplace. This provides the essential regional ground textures and environmental assets used for this scenery.
🛠️ Future Roadmap & Known Issues

While this version is fully flyable, I am committed to making this the best representation of Guyana possible. Here is what I am currently working on for future updates:

       * Terminal Night Lighting: Refining the emissive textures and light splashes on the main terminal for a more immersive "night owl" arrival experience.

       * Performance Optimization: Further tweaking of draw calls and polycounts to ensure a smooth experience for all systems.
       * LOD Adjustments: I am aware of some late Level of Detail (LOD) popping on specific models. A fix is in the works to ensure smoother transitions as you approach the airport.

### Dependencies

### Description

This is my first scenery project.
With a custom terminal model!

Johan Adolf Pengel International Airport, also known as Zanderij (named after the small village in which it's located), is the main international airport of my home country, Suriname. Locally, it's simply referred to as "Zanderij" by the people of Suriname.

During World War II, the airport was used by the Americans due to its strategic location and the availability of bauxite, a key resource for producing aluminum used in aircraft construction.

Today, the airport is served by several airlines including GOL, Suriname Airways, Copa Airlines, Caribbean Airlines, Fly All Ways, and KLM.

I created this scenery for Pengel because I felt the airport lacked an accurate and up-to-date representation. Since I don’t yet have the skills to create custom 3D models, I relied on existing libraries and some creative freedom to bring the airport to life.

Focus Areas:
Elevation: Added drainage along the runway.
Tree Placement: Improved tree placement on the approach to Runway 29 and Runway 11 (the trees always stood out to me when landing).
Textures: Apron, ground, and runway textures recreated as accurately as possible within my abilities.
Building and windsock Placement : As close to real life as possible.
Fencing: Included perimeter fencing for realism.
PAPI Light Placement: Positioned accurately for correct glide path indications.
Gate Layout: Some parking positions may not match ground markings precisely, but this reflects real-world conditions at the airport.
Required Libraries:
MSFS Deluxe Version (Germany Austria Sweden, Caribbean and Brazil world updates mostly used)
*For People experiencing ground texture issues = Materials are used from ( MUCL,ENRA ESNQ,SBSN) make sure you have those airports installed
EDHK Lights Pack https://flightsim.to/file/2549/edhk-lights-pack
MSFS Object Library https://flightsim.to/file/16007/msfs-object-library-with-150-models-ranging-from-towers-hangers-terminals-to-cones
Wombiiactual ENxx Asset Pack https://flightsim.to/file/12208/wombiiactual-enxx-asset-pack
Optional:

FSTL Static Aircraft Models (not required, but used for added realism)
Note: The airport may appear incomplete without these libraries in your Community folder.

I hope this scenery brings you as much enjoyment as I had creating it. Feedback is always welcome—let me know what you think!

Copy-Paste The package (kevinklein-airport-smjp-zandery) which is located inside the main folder (Johan Adolf Pengel airport)  into your Msfs 2020 community folder.

### Description

ENGLISH DESCRIPTION

Cuiabá International Airport - Marechal Rondon (SBCY) is an international airport located in the municipality of Várzea Grande, in Mato Grosso, eight kilometers from the center of Cuiabá. It is the main airport in the state and the third busiest in the Central-West region of Brazil.

Cuiabá International Airport receives flights from the following airlines:
- Azul (A320NEO/E195/E195-E2/ATR72-600/C208)
- Gol (B737-700/B737-800/B737-800BCF/B737-8 MAX)
- Latam (A319CEO/A320CEO/A321CEO/A320NEO/A321NEO)

**** IMPORTANT ****
- This airport was created from scratch by me (Bruno Reichert) for MSFS 2020, but it is compatible with MSFS 2024.
- Your MSFS must be up-to-date and have all update content installed/activated.
- World Update Brazil and World Update Japan must be installed/activated.
- If you have another SBCY scenery installed, uninstall it before installing this one to avoid conflicts.

Features:
- Customized and detailed objects
- 4K PBR textures
- Customized lighting
- Customized and detailed ground
- Realistic ground markings
- Corrected runway altitude and slope
- Terraform similar to the real airport
- Corrected taxi paths and parking spots
- Custom animated jetways

Special thanks to FSoares for helping me with the custom Jetways.

Installation: Extract the zip file to the community folder of your MSFS.

Donation Link

BRAZILIAN PORTUGUESE DESCRIPTION

Aeroporto Internacional de Cuiabá - Marechal Rondon (SBCY) é um aeroporto internacional localizado no município de Várzea Grande, em Mato Grosso, distante oito quilômetros do centro de Cuiabá. É o principal aeroporto do estado e sendo o terceiro mais movimentado do Centro-Oeste do Brasil.

O aeroporto de internacional de Cuiabá recebe voos das seguintes linhas aéreas:
- Azul (A320NEO/E195/E195-E2/ATR72-600/C208)
- Gol (B737-700/B737-800/B737-800BCF/B737-8 MAX)
- Latam (A319CEO/A320CEO/A321CEO/A320NEO/A321NEO)

**** IMPORTANTE ****
- Este aeroporto foi criado do zero por mim (Bruno Reichert) para o MSFS 2020, porém é compatível com MSFS 2024.
- Seu MSFS deve estar atualizado e com todos os conteúdos dos updates instalados/ativados.
- World Update Brazil e World Update Japão devem estar instalados/ativados.
- Se você possui outro cenário de SBCY instalado, desinstale o cenário antes de instalar este para evitar conflitos.

- Texturas PBR em 4K

- Solo customizado e detalhado

### Important advise for MSFS2020 users! Photogrammetry

There are two versions available for MSFS2020, the photogrammetry OFF file is the version NOT COMPATIBLE with photogrammetry, for those who fly with the WU19: Brazil photogrammetry disabled or not installed. The photogrammetry ON file is the version COMPATIBLE with the photogrammetry implemented in WU19: Brazil. Each file was developed for each specific case, using the wrong file may cause bugs. You do not need both files, install only one.
Brasília International Airport – Presidente Juscelino Kubitschek (IATA: BSB, ICAO: SBBR) is an international airport in the administrative region of Lago Sul, in the Federal District. It is the third largest airport in Brazil in terms of number of passengers transported and the first airport in South America to implement independent simultaneous parallel operations.

This is a scenery using the 3D models made by master Zanolli (Thank you for your willingness to provide the models for this project) for FSX and P3D, with only minor changes on my part. They represent the airport at the time they were created in 2015, so several aspects do not represent the real airport today. There is no forecast for updating the models.

A special thanks to Jeff, who was always willing to improve the quality of our simulation without any cost, and created the customized jetways used in this scenery. Check out his work here.

 

Features

  * Custom 3D models
  * Custom animated Jetways
  * Custom runway and taxi lights
  * Custom markings and ground pavement
  * Custom Aerial Image
  * Custom vehicle traffic inside the airport
  * Completely redone mesh

Installation

Just extract the rzanolli-airport-sbbr-brasilia folder to your Community folder.

This add-on features a detailed scenery representation of Belo Horizonte/Confins - Tancredo Neves International Airport (IATA: CNF, ICAO: SBCF) in Brazil.

### Description

This is my version of the scenery for Belo Horizonte/Confins - Tancredo Neves International Airport (IATA: CNF, ICAO: SBCF), that serves the city of Belo Horizonte, Minas Gerais state, Brazil. MSFS 2024 only.

I modeled the following objects:

- Passenger Terminals 1, 2, and 3.
- Control Tower.
- Cargo Terminal.
- GOL Maintenance Center.
- Services buildings.
- Linx Hotel.
- Clamper Workshop.

90% of the airport has been remodeled, featuring night lighting.
Functional Radio communication (ATIS and ATC) and radio navigation.
Functional arrival and departure procedures.
Taxiways and aprons with horizontal markings according to current ADC and PDC charts.

Installation: Simply download the ZIP file, extract it, and place the contents in your Community folder. Make sure there are no other SBCF scenario packages in your Community folder to avoid conflicts.

Use the comments section to make suggestions for this scenery or to request new airports.

I hope you enjoy it.

Interesting Information: The Airport is located in the municipality of Confins, in Minas Gerais, Brazil. It is the sixth busiest airport in the country and the main air terminal in the state, serving Belo Horizonte and its Metropolitan Region. The airport has the capacity to handle up to 32 million passengers per year and is able to receive large aircraft such as the Boeing 747, the Airbus A380 and the Antonov An-124.

The airport is a hub for Azul Linhas Aéreas and Focus City for GOL Linhas Aéreas, and is also served by LATAM Airlines, Copa Airlines, TAP Air Portugal, LATAM Chile and SKY Airline. Its facilities include a fully automated air cargo terminal, as well as a 3600 x 45 meter runway (the 4th largest in Brazil), equipped with an instrument landing system (ILS CAT I) and other air navigation aids.

Este update tem como objetivo melhorar as texturas para os não usuários de Zinertek. Nas outras versões, as texturas do solo ficavam boas para quem tinha o addon, mas percebi que não ficava legal para quem não tinha. Então substituí texturas praticamente no aeroporto inteiro para ficar melhor para ambos. Fiz uma parceria e já estamos desenvolvendo uma versão bem melhor de SBGL, porém continuo atualizando esta aqui para que até lá vocês consigam utilizar o cenario da melhor forma. Além disso, outras melhorias foram feitas, listadas abaixo: - Melhorias nas texturas do aeroporto inteiro - Correção das marcas de pneus nas pistas 10/15/28 (estava invisível para quem não tinha Zinertek) - Numeração no solo dos gates (gate 23 até 79) - Adição de algumas marcas de sujeira nos gates - Melhoria das árvores próximas a L1 OBS: Em alguns gates, a jetway se conecta na porta traseira da aeronave. Isso é um problema da Asobo, do cenário default, não tem relação com este cenário. Estamos tentando resolver. ---------- This update aims to improve textures for non-Zinertek users. In other versions, the ground textures were good for those who had the addon, but I realized that it wasn't good for those who didn't have it. So I replaced textures practically in the entire airport to make it better for both. I formed a partnership and we are already developing a much better version of SBGL, but I continue to update this one so that until then you can use the scenario in the best way. Additionally, other improvements were made, listed below: - Improvements to the textures of the entire airport - Correction of tire marks on tracks 10/15/28 (they were invisible to those who didn't have Zinertek) - Numbering on the ground of the gates (gate 23 to 79) - Added some dirt marks on the gates - Improvement of trees near L1 NOTE: In some gates, the jetway connects to the rear door of the aircraft. This is a problem with Asobo, with the default scenery, it has no relation to this addon. We are trying to solve it.--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

citeturn146search0 [wordlim: 200] Published: 3.0 years ago; Crawled: 2 weeks ago;   * Thanks to Nattani and nickb007 for the excellent 1435 flight Eurofighter Typhoon models and liveries, which are now included with this scenery as of v1.9.1. ... Explore the detailed RAF Mount Pleasant (EGYP) scenery in Microsoft Flight Simulator, featuring custom models, textures, and runway markings.

Image: EGYP - RAF Mount Pleasant - Image 1

Image: EGYP - RAF Mount Pleasant thumbnail 1Image: EGYP - RAF Mount Pleasant thumbnail 2Image: EGYP - RAF Mount Pleasant thumbnail 3Image: EGYP - RAF Mount Pleasant thumbnail 4Image: EGYP - RAF Mount Pleasant thumbnail 5Image: EGYP - RAF Mount Pleasant thumbnail 6Image: EGYP - RAF Mount Pleasant thumbnail 7Image: EGYP - RAF Mount Pleasant thumbnail 8Image: EGYP - RAF Mount Pleasant thumbnail 9Image: EGYP - RAF Mount Pleasant thumbnail 10Image: EGYP - RAF Mount Pleasant thumbnail 11Image: EGYP - RAF Mount Pleasant thumbnail 12

### Description

RAF Mount Pleasant (EGYP) is a Royal Air Force station in the south Atlantic. It is home to between 1,000 and 2,000 British military personnel, it remains the newest purpose-built RAF station. It is home to 1435 Flight, a Eurofighter Typhoon FGR.4 unit.

My aim is to offer a good approximation of RAF Mount Pleasant, and a significant improvement over the autogen, however it's not possible to be super accurate since there is very limited photographic reference material available - I'll strive to make it as good as I can within that scope! Countless hours have gone into this project - so if you like it please take the time to leave a review and rating below. 

I've made a wide range of improvements over the original autogen airport:

  * Custom models with PBR materials and textures for many buildings, including:
    * Main passenger terminal
    * Large main hangar (thanks to Vortex SD for helping out and creating this model!)
    * Hardened air shelters
    * Control tower
    * Hospital
    * Fire station
    * Dozens of misc hangars and warehouse buildings
  * Where custom models aren't used, most of the remaining autogen buildings have been replaced with more suitable Asobo models.
  * Replacement apron and taxiway textures, hand-drawn polygons to match satellite imagery materials
  * Replacement of all runways, parking and taxiways.
  * Terraforming everywhere. This has been quite a challenge to avoid any nasty transitions between taxiways while following the undulations of the terrain - drop me a message with details if you find any problems.
  * Static aircraft
  * Improved runway markings, arrestor cables etc, including custom model for RHAG.
  * Added clutter, vehicles and other airfield equipment
  * Added dirt, tyre marks, etc to improve realism
  * Added more painted lines to taxiways, roads, walkways, aircraft parking ramps, using custom painted line textures for improved realism vs the stock lines.

DEPENDENCIES

REQUIRED DEPENDENCY: I've used some models from the excellent RAF Lossiemouth scenery by nickb007 -  thank you for letting me do this Nick. You do not need any of the seven dependencies listed as required for RAF Lossiemouth.

OPTIONAL DEPENDENCY: We Love VFR region 1, for the radio mast models.

REQUIRED DEPENDENCY: Various Sim, World and City Updates. If in doubt I suggest you install them all, but I've definitely used several buildings from Oceania World Update XIII.

CREDITS

  * The static RAF A330 MRTT was supplied by Superspud. Do check out his extensive collection of scenery here if you haven't done so already!
  * The static Sikorsky S92 model was adapted from an FSX model by John Young at Military AI Works. John kindly gave permission for me to use his model in this scenery. I have created the Bristow Helicopters livery from scratch using John's paintkit.
  * Thanks to Paul64 for his detailed feedback on Mount Pleasant, and for sharing some models which I hope to update and include in future updates.
  * The static British Antarctic Survey Dash-7 has been adapted from the freeware model by Milton Shupe, John Kelly et al*. My understanding from Milton's statement on FSDeveloper.com is that this model was made available and free to adapt and publish providing (A) the adaptation is freeware, (B) proper credit is given to the original authors and (C) the original source model is not redistributed.
    * Credit to Milton Shupe for the Dash 7 model
    * Credit to John Kelly for the BAS texture
* If Milton, John or any other original authors are not happy with me including this static model then please reach out to me and I'll remove it immediately.
  * Land Rover Defender 90 model adapted from this model by kekis69 under Creative Commons Attribution license.
  * Thanks to Nattani and nickb007 for the excellent 1435 flight Eurofighter Typhoon models and liveries, which are now included with this scenery as of v1.9.1.

### Description

Mare Harbour, known colloquially as East Cove Port, is a small settlement on East Falkland, on Choiseul Sound. It is mostly used as a port facility and depot for RAF Mount Pleasant as well as a deepwater port used by the Royal Navy ships patrolling the South Atlantic and Antarctica, which means that the main harbour of the islands, Stanley Harbour tends to deal with commercial transport.

This scenery uses a mix of stock Asobo models and some custom models. While not a detailed and exact replica of Mare Harbour, it should provide a reasonable likeness when flying over the area, and certainly an improvement over the autogen scenery which was there before! The addon has been updated for MSFS 2024 - my other Falklands scenery will be getting updated in due course.

### Description

#### SAWO is the acronym of the ICAO/ICAO code that identifies this small airport in the city of USHUAIA, Tierra del Fuego, Argentine Republic. (here)

A little history:

It began as an auxiliary station of the Argentine Navy around 1933 to become Naval Air Station Ushuaia a decade later (1949). In 1970 the runway of the Ushuaia Naval Air Base was extended to 1400 meters, and then in 1987, it reaches the current 1697 meters.

It began to have regular services around 1947 (DC-3 Aeroposta Argentina) and then in its place the new company Aerolineas Argentinas (1950) linking Buenos Aires with several cities in Argentine Patagonia. At the end of the 1960s, the first Twin Otter DHC-6 and Fokker F-27 (LADE) appeared.

In 1984, Aerolineas Argentinas operated with the Boeing 737-287 (mod. Advanced) where it continued until 1995, when the new international airport of Ushuaia SAWH was inaugurated.

It currently functions as an aerodrome, headquarters of the Ushuaia Naval Air Base (BAU) Almirante Berisso, the Ushuaia Aeroclub and helicopter tourist services.

Stage

This is an improved version of the SAWO airport for entertainment and gaming purposes, since it has incorporated runway lights, taxi, papi, as well as buildings and some models of aircraft (super etendard) of the Argentine Navy that do not operate in this base. .

It is intended to be flown VFR (I think that has not changed so far). Enjoy the approach bordering the city from Mount Olivia towards the Ushuaia prison following the trajectory of route 3, turning left towards runway 16, crossing the city and the port.

3D building models were created, submerged areas in the coastline were corrected (the port was made complete), much of the scenery was terraformed, 4 missing docks were added, a fuel storage plant was added and some references for VFR , such as the red-roofed factory. A fines de los 60 aparecen los primeros Twin Otter DHC-6 y Fokker F-27 (LADE).

En 1984, Aerolíneas Argentinas opero con el Boeing 737-287 (mod. Advanced) donde continuo hasta 1995, cuando se inauguro el nuevo aeropuerto internacional de Ushuaia SAWH.

Actualmente funciona como aeródromo, sede de la base aeronaval Ushuaia (BAU) Almirante Berisso, del Aeroclub Ushuaia y servicios turísticos de helicópteros.

 

El escenario

Esta es una versión mejorada del aeropuerto SAWO para fines de entretenimiento y de juego, ya que se incorporo luces de pista, taxi, papi, ademas de edificios y algunos modelos de aviones (súper etendard) de la Armada Argentina que no operan en esta base.

Esta pensado para volarlo VFR (creo que eso no ha cambiado hasta ahora). Disfruten de la aproximación bordeando la ciudad desde el monte Olivia hacia el presidio de Ushuaia siguiendo la trayectoria de la ruta 3, virando a la izquierda hacia la pista 16, atravesando la ciudad y el puerto.

### Description

There have been reports that some of the airfields have been surrounded by trees (maybe due to serious global warming) in FS2024, but it seems that it have been fixed after SU3.

It is quite a surprising fact that there are flights to Antarctica using ordinary airliner, so I tried to get the informations of airfields in Antarctica. In the recent version, there are 20 airfields have been added:

  * Boulder Clay Runway (AQBC)
  * Concordia (AT03)
  * D85 Skiway (AT05)
  * Fossil Bluff Skiway (AT10)
  * Kohnen Station Skiway (AT12)
  * Mid Point Skiway (AT14)
  * Molodezhnaya (AT15)
  * Neumayer Station Skiway (AT16)
  * Novolazarevskaya (AT17)
  * Odell Glacier (AT18)
  * Sanae IV Skiway (AT22)
  * Sky Blu (AT24)
  * Troll (AT27/ENOE)+#
  * Vostok Station Skiway (AT28)
  * Halley Station Skiway (EGAH)
  * Phoenix Field (NZFX)+#
  * Union Glacier Runway (SCGC)
  * Wolf's Fang Runway (AT98/WICE)+#
  * O'Higgins Skiway (SCBO)*
  * Wilkins Runway (YWKS)+#

Those airfields with (*) are built on sea ice. From the results of test flights, you can't start a flight from these airfields as aircraft will sink into water, or immediately end up in a crash. On the other hand, you must see that sea ice has been built up on the area for landing. As there are no reference about the landscape near the airfields, landing at night is dangerous especially during winter, where wind speed equivalent to a hurricane is usual.

Why there is no South Pole Station Airfield (NZSP)? The answer is not that straight forward. Most of the web mapping providers adapt the WGS 84/Pseudo-Mercator (EPSG:3857) as the projection standard, which the highest latitude supported is 85.05° north/south. Terrain beyond this latitude could not be rendered properly. In fact I've tried different methods to place the runway near the Geographic South Pole, but it failed to give anything meaningful, and only something erroneous as the result. However, I've placed a POI on it, so you can still try to fly there.

The snow groomers at the airports are from the Winter Asset Pack by Usatix, download this library here otherwise they will not show up.

True bearings (sometimes Grid bearings) should be used for navigation, as magvar over the continent varies a lot even for a short distance, and the value could even be as much as 180 degrees if you're flying somewhere between the Magnetic South Pole and Geographic South Pole.

  * SCGC - "UGL" / 360kHz
  * AT17 - "NV" / 280kHz
  * AQBC - "BC" / 340Hz

Ground handlings

There are 4 airports (marked by #) with apron being explicitly defined, with parking bay assigned. Only Phoenix Field and Troll Airport have refuelling available.

I have also made the livery of Skytraders for A230neo, although they use A319 in real life.

To look for the missing airstrips on the other side of the Earth, you may have interest for the Arctic Airstrip Bunble by me.

As part of this process, all airports currently modelled in the scenery were cross-checked against their real-world locations and available reference data, resulting in a number of position, layout and airport-reference corrections.

HomeAddonsScenery EnhancementsRegional BundlesAirports of Antarctica

### Description

### Explore the White Continent in MSFS 2024!

(Opening scene, skip to ‘What you get’ if you are in a hurry to learn about the add-on content)

Welcome to Antarctica, the coldest, driest, windiest and emptiest continent on Earth — and the only continent without an indigenous human population.

Almost everything that sustains human activity in Antarctica arrives by ship or by air: every scientist, every drum of fuel, every spare part, every ounce of food, every module of every station. The ships reach the coast; aircraft bridge the immense distances beyond — landing on wheels on blue ice, on skis on groomed skiways, or on unprepared snow far from any station. Down here, flying is not recreation — it is what holds the continent together. And yet the sky itself is empty. No contrails, no traffic overhead — just clear, unmarked blue.

Click to expand

Fly south and the world empties out. ### What You Get

Airports of Antarctica is an MSFS 2024 scenery bundle that is building a continent-wide network of Antarctic airfields, opening up much of the White Continent to aircraft operations.

In its current state, this add-on includes 29 airports, skiways, runways and helipads, together with station enhancements, camps and 5 dedicated points of interest (POI).

Combined with the freeware and payware scenery packages referenced in the included manual, the Antarctic network currently expands to 46 airfields and 46 points of interest across the continent.

Fly from the tip of the Antarctic Peninsula deep into the interior, or from the Ross Ice Shelf across to Dronning Maud Land. Cross McMurdo Sound to Marble Point, the refuelling stop for helicopters working the Dry Valleys. Fly the deep-field run from Novo to Kohnen. Run the Peninsula circuit between the Argentine, Chilean, Brazilian, Polish and Peruvian stations. Or set down at Vostok on the high Antarctic Plateau, where the lowest air temperature on Earth was recorded.
  * The Antarctica Overview Map — a continent-wide map showing the locations of airfields, research stations, camps and other key destinations covered by the scenery and its companion directories
  * Detailed information for each implemented airfield and point of interest — from practical airfield data for flying in the simulator to real-world background on the airfield and its associated station, maps, further reading, historical context, and interesting facts and stories
  * Links to freeware and payware scenery needed for complete coverage of Antarctica
  * Further information on the project goals, design guidelines and the level of detail users can expect from the different scenery locations

All information in the manual was gathered with great attention to detail, drawing on national Antarctic programme publications, aviation databases, academic sources, satellite images, Wikipedia and other published references. Airfields are positioned and modelled as accurately as the available source material allows — so even the simplest skiway is located where its real-world counterpart should be.

### Breadth Before Depth

This package is built to make the whole continent accessible, not to model any single station in depth. The airfields are intentionally simple and the surrounding terrain is largely left as generated by the simulator. That keeps performance sensible across a scenery the size of a continent — and where a dedicated add-on already covers a site in greater detail, the manual points you to it instead of duplicating that work.

A number of Antarctic airfields are deliberately left out, typically because they are permanently closed or abandoned. The manual lists every excluded site along with the reason.

-

# Airports of Antarctica

'Airports of Antarctica' is an MSFS 2024 scenery bundle building a continent-wide network of Antarctic airfields. It includes 30+ scenery elements, with 29 airports, skiways, runways and helipads, plus station enhancements, camps and POIs. Airfields are placed as accurately as available sources allow, following their real-world locations. An extensive manual adds simulator-relevant data, real-world background, maps, history, stories and further reading.

### Description

Chiclayo v1.0 (SPHI for MSFS)

Capitán FAP José A. Quiñones González International Airport (IATA: CIX, ICAO: SPHI) is an airport serving Chiclayo, Peru and the surrounding metropolitan area. It is run by ADP, a private airport operator that operates various airports in northern Peru. It is the main airport of the Lambayeque Region, one of the most populous regions of Peru. Lambayeque is an important place for tourism in Perú with 3 museums and lots of places where to eat delicious seafood, and agroindustrial exportation. The airport is named after Jose Quiñones Gonzalez, an FAP pilot who was killed during the Ecuadorian-Peruvian War of 1941.

It serves domestic flights operated by LATAM Perú, SKY Perú and Viva Air Perú. Also connects to Tocumen International Airport (MPTO) in Panamá, with Copa Airlines, establishing an important link between Perú and Central América. The construction of a new airport and new domestic routes connecting Iquitos, Cusco and Arequipa. This will make Chiclayo an important HUB for domestic and international flights.
 
The airport is also used by the Peruvian Air Force (Spanish: Fuerza Aérea del Perú, FAP). It hosts one of the Air Force's two air superiority/interceptor squadrons, Escuadrón Aéreo 612 (Fighter Squadron 612 "Fighting Cocks"). The blast shelters housing the squadron's Mig 29 aircraft are visible from the airport runways.

Actually,  this airport is running Phase C of a rehabilitation program and improvement of airside (PRMLA SPHI) and during 2022 RWY 01/19 will be closed and parallel TWY D shall be enabled as RWY 01R/19L. See attached diagram to know actual landing, taxiing and takeoff procedures.

this airport will be updated as the program advances in execution.

Cadete FAP Guillermo del Castillo Paredes Airport (IATA: TPP, ICAO: SPST) is an airport serving Tarapoto, Peru. It is owned by CORPAC S.A, a government organization that oversees the management of Peruvian airports, but it is run by Aeropuertos del Perú (ADP) S.A, as a concession. It is the main airport of the San Martín Region, located in the Amazon, and is used by many tourists as a jumping-off point for trips into the jungle.The airport is currently served by LATAM Perú, Star Peru, JetSmart Perú. SAETA and Sky Perú. By now, the airport is also connected to Chiclayo (SPHI) and Iquitos (SPQT) via direct regional flights operated by Star Peru airlines.

Known as the City of Palm Trees, Tarapoto is located in the department of San Martín, at the foot of the Blue Mountain Range and at the confluence of the Cumbaza and Shilcayo rivers. Its typically tropical climate, the joy of its people and the proximity to Lamas and Sauce, make it an important tourist destination in the Peruvian jungle. With a population of 187,320 inhabitants, its strategic geographical location allows it to be an important trading point between San Martín and Loreto. Among its main economic activities is the cultivation of products such as coffee, cocoa, rice, bananas, papaya and beans. Tourism also plays an important role since Tarapoto is a destination of tropical forests, waterfalls, such as Huacamaíllo or Tununtunumba, and towns made up of a mixed population of natives and mestizos such as Lamas. Visited by people who come from all over the world, Tarapoto is the perfect setting to rest, eat delicious food, experience adventure and, above all, discover the wonders of nature.

The runway length of 2,255 metres (7,398 ft) does not include a 350 metres (1,150 ft) displaced threshold on the northern end.
The Tarapoto non-directional beacon (Ident: TAP) is located on the field.[3] The Tarapoto VOR-DME (Ident: TAP) is located 9.0 nautical miles (16.7 km) south of the airport.
