## About this addon

José Joaquín de Olmedo International Airport (Spanish: Aeropuerto Internacional José Joaquín de Olmedo; IATA: GYE, ICAO: SEGU) is the airport serving Guayaquil, the capital of the Guayas Province and the second most populous city in Ecuador. It is the second busiest airport in Ecuador.

In July 2014 the airport domestic area was enlarged; now the airport is capable of handling up to 7.5 million passengers per year. An exit tax is levied on all international tickets, however it is no longer required to pay at the window when exiting the country.

ecosystem. The project was announced in 2008, with construction commencing in 2012. The purpose
of the redevelopment from the outset was to create the world's first ecological airport. ECOGAL was
awarded a 15-year concession to administer and operate the airport.

The Galapagos non-directional beacon (Ident: GLS) is located 1.0 nautical mile (1.9 km) off the
approach threshold of Runway 14. The Galapagos VOR-DME (Ident: GLV) is located on the field.
During World War II, the airport (known as Seymour Island Airfield) was used by the United States

I (KAZE) am a foreigner and do not understand English, so I am using translation software.

 

Toncontin is the most difficult airport in the world for landing jet planes.

It is difficult because the hill just before landing is high and it is necessary to fly just above the ground.
The default Toncontin had some strange parts, so I fixed it and made it realistic.

The runway has a slope of 20M, just like in reality. RWY 02 is 1005M, RWY 20 is 985M.

In 2006, a video of Toncontin's landing with a woman's voice saying, "Don't be surprised" was posted on YouTube, and I was very moved by it.When you look out the window of an airplane, it looks like you're on a high-speed train as it flies on the ground.
 It is only when this is recreated that Toncontin's landing becomes attractive.
Toncontin Airport is recorded as a handmade airport by default in MSFS, but undulations are not accurate.
Therefore I wanted to fix this.

This is a video taken from inside the plane of the landing that I used as a reference. ↓
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=5WoSZFnBMPk&ab_channel=ShadiaMej%C3%ADa

In August 1942, No. 111 (Coastal) Operational Training Unit RAF was established at Nassau Airport to train general reconnaissance crews using the North American Mitchell and Consolidated Liberators.
Oakes International Airport was kept in operation until midnight, 1 November 1957, when Nassau International Airport at Windsor Field was brought into full operation.

### Description

Mexico City International Airport (Benito Juárez) MMMX

This EARLY RELEASE package includes:

  * Custom Terminal 1 model, with detailed 1-8 gates and international gates.
  * Custom Terminal 2 model, with detailed control tower and National Guard hangar.
  * Custom control tower model (SENEAM).

This is a huge airport, so I will do a rolling release. Next version will include:

  * Completely redrawn taxiway network and surfaces.
  * Increased detail in Terminal 1.
  * SimObjects and scenery objects (airplanes, tugs, cars).
  * Terminal 2 extension.
  * Presidential hangar and nearby buildings (AeroMexico, Aeromar).

Install by dragging the "continuo-airport-mmmx-mexico-city" folder inside the .zip file to your Community folder. You may locate that folder using this guide: https://www.flightsim.com/vbfs/content.php?21235-Finding-The-MSFS-2020-Community-Folder.

96268.body:
(MMSD) San Jose del Cabo for MSFS 2024 - Airports for MSFS | Flightsim.to (https://flightsim.to/addon/96268/mmsd-san-jose-del-cabo-for-msfs-2024)
citeturn166search4 [wordlim: 200] Crawled: 2 weeks ago; This add-on provides a comprehensive overhaul of San Jose del Cabo Airport (MMSD) for Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024.

### Description

This is a heavy modification to MMSD for MSFS2024 (only MSFS2024)

MMSD is one of Mexico's most popular airports (and destinations) handling more than 7 million passengers per year. It has over 50 destinations, and it is heavily favored by Mexican, and US airlines. SJD boasts a MASSIVE GA ramp with a ton of  jet parking, so it you're into bizjets this is the place for you. Airlines that commonly visit SJD include (but are not limited to) Alaska, Aeromexico, United, American, Viva, Volaris, Aerocalafia, Frontier, Southwest, Westjet, and more! We are staying with v1 at this timne, since this package is for 2024 ONLY, and not a continuation of our previous (and unavailable) version. This package has been purpose-built for msfs2024 from scratch, and no msfs2020 version is planned.

 

This scenery package includes, among other things:

-Hundreds of hand-placed items around the entire airport area
-Custom terrain profile matching the real airport (except at the south end of T2, ramp area)
-Custom- built Terminals, towers, and more
-Updated materials, reflecting the latest available airport layout
-Correct taxiway naming, and properly setup paths for AI traffic (tested with AIG, Beyond ATC)
-Correct gate naming and assigments
-GSX compatible (profile being built, but if anyone wishes to create one, feel free to let us know and we'll make it official)
-Compatible with default navigation database, and Navigraph
-Corrected dry riverbed around the area, which was an immersion killer
-Carefuly placed, hand made ground textures and decals
-And much more!

Installation: 
1. Unzip the .RAR file 
2. Place the folder hss-airport-mmsd-sanjosev2 in your MSFS2024 "community" folder.

For support, please contact us at:
hsssimulations@gmail.com

Do NOT re-upload this package or any of its contents to any other website without explicit permission from us.Do NOT use any of this package's content for any other purpose than for use within MSFS.

### Description

This is a modification to the default MMHO airport in MSFS. All modifications are done using Microsoft's SDK and some custom textures.

Features include:

  * - Taxiways are properly assigned and mapped
  * - Gates are re-worked and re-numbered
  * - Runway materials updated for more realism, using custom textures
  * - Added night lighting to ramp areas, terminals, hangars, and many more buildings
  * - Custom terminals, military buildings, offices, etc.
  * - Hand-painted many taxi and apron lines for a more authentic feel using custom textures and pbr
  * - Modified and/ or replaced  many buildings within the airport area for more immersion
  * - Many custom ground markings
  * - Added night lights to roads leading to airport, as in MANY cases, msfs does not place them there at all

****NOTAM***
- This is an unfinished project. Most of the buildings you expect to see are there and the airport has full funcionality, however, it started as a payware project more than a year ago and due to time constraints we just left it there. 

-*********************************FOR THE DISSAPEARING JETWAY LINKS********************

-This issue has FINALLY been acknowledged by Asobo, however there is no current ETA or known fix (apart from using custom jetways). In the future, we may use custom jetways from Asobo's WU airports, but for now we all have to live with the possibility of the jetways dissapearing

-More Mexican airports to come in the future!
-Follow us on Facebook: HSS Facebook page.

-Come say hi in our official discord! this is also used for support.  HSS Discord

Update Version 1.4 -Made for AMSIM BMWorld KPHX compatibility.

### Description

 

Update Version 1.4

-Made for AMSIM BMWorld KPHX compatibility.  Did more de-treeing on factories and powerplants - fixed some bridges and waterways in the approach paths to Sky Harbor from both ends.

Update Version 1.3

-Adds a few palm trees to the west end of sky harbor, papago park, midtown,downtown, and arcadia. Unfortunately, there is no real analog for the type of palm trees we have here in Arizona. There is no 50 foot stick with 4 sickly looking palm fronds so I had to use a combination of Palm_Tree and Date_Tree. The biomes have a mind of their own so there are a few issues here an there with sizes and types. The SDK is WYSIWYG to a certain exent but wierd stuff happens when messing with AI vegetation.

-Fixes transitions in San Tan Mountains and north of 101 near Scottsdale. 

-Adjusted cactus density over most of the map favoring less density.

### Description

Salt Lake City International Airport is a civil-military airport located about 4 miles west of Downtown Salt Lake City, Utah, in the United States. The airport is the closest commercial airport for more than 2.5 million people and is within a 30-minute drive of nearly 1.3 million jobs. The airport serves as a hub for Delta Air Lines and is a major gateway to the Intermountain West and West Coast. The airport sees 343 scheduled nonstop airline departures per day to 93 cities in North America and Europe. It is by far the busiest airport in Utah.

Salt Lake City International Airport continues to rank high for on-time departures/arrivals and the fewest flight cancellations among major US airports. The airport ranked first for on-time departures and arrivals and first for the percentage of cancellations as of April 2017. The airport is owned by the City of Salt Lake City and is administered by the municipal Department of Airports.

Custom buildings for the Terminal, FBO's, ATC Tower, and FedEx warehouse. And Stock buildings replace most of the auto-generated buildings around the airport. And everything is well lit at night. With Ramp Lights, Edge Lights, and in pavement lights.

Custom Airport Buildings graciously provided by b757.

* * *

Note on MSFS 2024

I do not use MSFS 2024 as my PC is old and can't run it. So until i can get the money together to build a new PC I cannot offically confirm any of my scenerys work in 2024. 

However, Atleast 6 users have reported this scenery works in 2024. But Since I can't confirm it myself I will leave it marked as 2020 only. Just know if you want to it seems you can use this scenery in MSFS 2024.

Install

  * Extract the ZIP file to a temp location (like the desktop)
  * Inside the Extracted Folder, locate the despamods-kslc-custom folder.
  * Place that folder inside your community folder

Optional Downloads

The following is some optional mods that you can download to make the scenery look better. They are by no means required however, but highly recommended

We Love VFR

A Large mod that places objects like power lines, wind turbines, smoke stacks and other objects all around the world.

TurtleTanks Objects

Various Airport Objects to enhance the airport. Required to see the runway distance remaining signs alongside the runway's

Japan Airports Models

As of Version 1.1.0, This pack is requiered! Various Airport Objects to Enhance the airport. And custom jetways.

Superspud Airport Assets

Various Airport vehicles. Such as Catering trucks, GPU Carts, and De-Ice Trucks.

FSLTL

Free AI Traffic Addon. I use some of the models as Static Aircraft around the Airport. You Don't Need the Injector, just the models.

Special Thanks to b757, AKA Chris B for allowing me to use their buildings in this project. And for making a few new ones at my request. Be sure to theck out their sceneries to.

Daniel K. Inouye International Airport, formerly known as Honolulu International Airport, is the largest international airport in the state of Hawaii, U.S.A. It is located on the island of Oahu, west of downtown Honolulu.

This package adds two towers designed to more closely resemble the real-world towers at PHNL. The package also adds the breezeways between the main terminal building and the C and G concourses, the open-air gates extending east from the G concourse, the Mauka concourse, the HAL maintenance and cargo buildings, the ARFF building on the north side of runway 8L/26R, the United maintenance hangar, and a few other items here and there. I used a generic apartment building from the Asobo library as a stand in for the FDC building.

### Description

          I almost abandoned this project when Asobo released World Update XIII. Their version of PHKO has a lot to offer. Nevertheless, some people might like to see a different version. My latest update brings some things into alignment with the latest aerial imagery, and fixes a few shortcomings of my original release.

The airport: Ellison Onizuka Kona International Airport at Keahole (PHKO) is one of two international airports located on the island of Hawai’i. PHKO is located on the leeward side of the island, while Hilo International is located on the windward side. 

            The airport has gone through a number of name changes since its construction in 1970. The current name honors Kona native Ellison Onizuka, an astronaut who died in the Space Shuttle Challenger disaster of 1986. “Keahole” refers to Keahole Point, the projection of land created by the lava flow of 1801. 

            A modernization project began in 2017. The project included the creation of a centralized security checkpoint, the construction of a large baggage facility, and the demolition of the Onizuka museum and the old tower.

            I am grateful to polyhaven.com, ambientcg.com, and pexels.com for their assortment of royalty-free textures and images.

            I am also grateful to Patrick Germain for his airport2project app, which helped me create a starting point for this package.

Installation: Unzip, and place the phko-airport-kona folder in your community folder. This airport package is contained in one folder only. If you see more than one phko folder in your community folder, please remove any older versions before launching MSFS.

          Next, you'll need to remove Asobo's PHKO to prevent overlapping scenery elements. Launch MSFS. From the main menu, go to "Profile." From there, go to "Content Manager." Search for Asobo's PHKO. I think the easiest way to do that is to use the search window in Content Manager. Type in PHKO, and two items should appear. One is the World Update XIII: Oceania and Antarctica file, and the other is PHKO Airport Kona by Lima Juliet. Move your cursor over the World Update XIII file, and a blue rectangle should appear to the right, with a set of dots and lines that look like a bulleted list. Left click on the blue rectangle, and the components of WU XIII will be revealed. Select the "PHKO KONA AIRPORT" entry, and then click on the "Delete" option at the bottom of the screen.

          If you grow weary of my version of PHKO and want to put it back the way it was, it'll entail a two-step process similar to the one above. In addition to removing my package from your community folder, you'll need to reinstall Asobo's version. From the main menu in MSFS, go to "Profile," and then to "Content Manager." Search for Asobo's PHKO, as above. Open the World Update XIII file again, and select "PHKO KONA AIRPORT." This time, an Install option will come up at the bottom of the screen.

This version of the scenery package contains a giant ground texture with georeferencing and some clutter. It is compatible with other PHTO airport or scenery.

### Description

This scenery project enhances Henderson Field (ICAO:PMDY) with a custom hangar and other detailing work themed with our team flag and colours. This location was chosen as we have used Henderson Field for nearly all of our development testing, with hundreds, if not thousands of flights flown.

The hangar was custom-made in-house and was inspired by the C-17 hangars at Travis AFB. The control tower is also fully custom, based on the Hill AFB tower. We plan on enhancing this map in the future with more custom sceneries and details. Please keep in mind that this is not meant for realism, this is entirely fictional in nature.

If you are interested in contributing we have this on our GitHub. https://github.com/Delta-Simulations/MSFS-Midway-Atoll . We are looking for scenery developers who can give guidance on how to implement the hangar door XML, please reach out!

Thank you to ProjektZeroGaming for setting the airport up and creating the taxi and runway details. You can check out his work here.

This scenery represents the USN Naval Air Station Wake Island, located on Wake Island. It is depicted in the state before the famous battle of Wake Island in 1941 and the subsequent invasion by the Imperial Japanese Navy.

it includes :

* Features Historical Wake Island airfield depiction based on historical charts and pictures.

### Description

Roman Tmetuchl International Airport, also known as Palau International Airport is the main airport of Palau. It is located near the former capital Koror, just north of Ngetkib, Airai on Babeldaob island. The airport is 4 miles (6 km) from Koror and 15 miles (25 km) from Ngerulmud. The airport covers an area of 480 acres (190 ha) at an elevation of 176 feet (54 m) above mean sea level. It has one runway designated 9/27 with an asphalt and concrete surface measuring 7,200 by 150 feet (2,194 x 45 m). For the 12-month period ending December 13, 2004, the airport had 1,142 aircraft operations, an average of 95 per month: 78% scheduled commercial, 10% air taxi, 8% general aviation and 4% military.

### Description

Welcome to Funafuti, Tuvalu, a pacific paradise. This mod adds lots of detail to Funafuti airport. Bunches of static and moving ships, including a landable cruise ship roam the seas nearby. Beware of them on approach to runway 21 if you decide to arrive in bad weather! Over time I developed this add on from just the airport to covering the whole country in detail so go and have a flight to explore. POI markers will lead the way if necessary.

This is my first scenery creation for MSFS. Month of fighting and learning the SDK caused me a good amount of grey hair. Since I had to invest enormous amounts of time, 3 wifes and 8 of my 9 kids left me. As a fair compensation I asked flightsim.to for a buy-me-a-house or buy-me-a-new-car button but they left me with that stupid coffee. So at least make it big. I like it black, no sugar. Let it be served by a sweet young waitress so I can at least do something about the wife issue.

Funafuti is a fun airport and you can take it literally. If you think it has a taxiway, you are wrong. This is a regular road that crosses the airport and aprons. So Asobos AI-cars driving there are quite realistic. The airport shares a large part of the narrow island with a small town. Both are well integrated into each other and it was sometimes hard to decide wether a default building was part of the one or the other. There are no fences and no barriers so the simple traffic rule seems to be: the one arriving from above has the right of way. This airport is more of a playground, a park or a football field. There are only 3 flights a week by Fiji Link in their ATR 72-600, so the rest of the week the airport is to the people. Watch the video down below for a new idea on how to use an airport!

Although the runway is 1,650 m long and can accomodate A320-class aircraft, the two tiny aprons are much happier with a single ATR or the likes. Two aircraft at a time? Bad idea! If you arrive in an A320, you might like to use the soccer field for business parking. I added a proper grandstand so you can find it.

Don't miss the hot ladies and guys on the beach when approaching runway 21. Fly slow and low. But don't use drone mode to spy on them. That's inappropriate. Give them some privacy!

Enjoy Funafuti!!!

 

Tuvalu Expansion

Since this is my first international airport and the favourite of my own sceneries, I could not resist expanding this mod further. Now it covers the whole country of Tuvalu. Interestingly two new airfields popped up on Google Maps, that were under construction in 2023. I found no information on them whatsoever but of course I had to include them in my scenery. They are shown in the state of construction. You find them on the islands of Vaitupu and the most northern island Nanumea. The latter was once an army airfield during WWII, that the Americans used during their island hopping campaign. B-24-bombers, Wildcats and other Navy planes took off from here. It was decomissioned after the war and quickly grown over by forest. Now it seems it was revived. Good idea after all. If you felt, that Funafuti with its international airport is one of the remotest places on earth, these islands are even more remote with hours or days of travel by ship only to reach Funafuti, from where you can fly to Fiji and from there into the rest of the world.

I added detail to all of the seven islands or atolls of Tuvalu. You will find churches, solar panels, boats and a few people. The space in between is roamed by plenty of sailing and fishing boats. I will add a lot more detail in future. Some atolls have poor satellite imagery so I did some repair and planted lots of trees where they were missing.

Grab your favourite amphibious plane and go exploring the country of Tuvalu. It stretches about 600 km from north to south, so you'll be busy for a while. Follow the POI-markers, that give you the names of all islands.

Installation

There are two files available for download:

Main Version

Optional Fun on the Runway Version: An optional add-on that adds lots of people, animals and fun stuff on Funafuti runway. This is how it is used most of the time. Install parallel with the main version.

The main scenery consists of three files. Please drop all of them into your community folder. Add the dependencies below.

Version 1.25, November 2023 - corrected terraforming and object placement issues which appeared after WU XIII - color-adjusted custom palm tree textures to better match default vegetation - corrected ground-poly opacity to let the underlying satellite imagery be visibible in the airport area - added lots of new palm trees, rocks, vegetation and some clutter objects from the WU XIII update OPTIONAL: - added some clutter objects from the beautiful Emerald Scenery Design object library which can be downloaded on the Marketplace or here: https://de.flightsim.to/file/8824/emerald-object-library

### Description

Hi everyone, this is my very first scenery project, Queen Lavinia Airport on the tiny remote island of Niuafo'ou which belongs to the kingdom of Tonga in the South Pacific.
I originally started this project shortly after P3D V4 was released, because I had an Air Hauler 2 company based off Faleolo International Airport (Samoa) which was part of the excellent NSTU package by ORBX. Additionally, I bought the old Tonga Domestic Airports scenery by PacSim to have some more destinations to fly to, but NFTO was missing from this package and in fact completely missing in the default database (probably because it only sees one flight every few weeks and there are only a handful of reference photos and several years old videos found on the internet, so much of the scenery is more of an artistic interpretation than an exact represantation of the real world). So I decided to create this small addon and I used it as a test project to learn Blender and the various P3D developer tools. However, after some basic modeling I abandoned the project because I just didn´t have the time to do all the photoreal optimization and autogen annotation. 

# NFTO - Queen Lavinia Airport - Niuafo'ou - Tonga

Experience the remote charm of Queen Lavinia Airport on the pristine island of Niuafoou in Tonga with this meticulously crafted scenery add-on for Microsoft Flight Simulator. Designed with passion and attention to detail, this project brings to life a destination previously missing from the simulators database. Explore this unique location and provide valuable feedback to help the developer enhance their skills for future endeavors. Simply unzip the folder into your MSFS community directory to start your adventure.

Fakaalofa Lahi Atu and welcome to Niue Hanan International Airport (ICAO:NIUE), located on the Pacific island of Niue. It serves as the nations only airport and was opened in 1970. ANZ 934 and ANZ 935 are the only scheduled international flights which operate in and out of the airport. These flighst are operated by Air New Zealand out of Auckland International (NZAA) and back using their A320ceo and A320neo aircraft. 

V1.0:

  *  Accurate Runway markings and textures
  *  Usable parking with working ground services (not including fuel truck)
  *  Trees removed from behind runway 
  * Removed all default buildings and replaced with more accurate buildings (not custom textured)
  * Added fencing around perimeter
  * Added wind socks
  * Added more accurate vegetation 
  * Added apron and runway lighting 

Installation Instructions:

  * Download file
  * extract 'NIUE' and open 'packages'
  * move 'lswain-airport-niue-niue-island' to community folder

Norfolk Island Airport (YSNF), is located in the Pacific Ocean between Australia, New Zealand and New Caledonia. Milford Sound Airport (IATA: MFN, ICAO: NZMF) is a small but very busy (in terms of flight movements) airport in Milford Sound, in New Zealand's Fiordland region of the South Island. It is mainly used by tourist / flightseeing operators.
The Airport is located in the village Milford Sound located at the head of the fiord Milford Sound. It serves the Milford Sound tourism industry including boats, kayaks, Milford Track, as well as the fishing boats based at Milford Sound. It stands at the head of the fiord at the junction of the Cleddau and Arthur rivers.

### Description

Another release supported and created by the AIG community. This mod aims to significantly improve and increase the AI operations at FlyTampa's Sydney YSSY. You will see a significant increase in AI aircraft spawning and opened gates. The original airport is required. 

 

* * *

The original FlyTampa YSSY paware airport is required.

* * *

Features

  * Updated airline coding sampled early-mid August 2024.
  * Fixed ground routes, specifically:
    * Taxi routes where aircraft would take the longer route
    * Taxi routes where aircraft would taxi onto the runway only to exit the next high speed (Atributted with sharp taxi link angles)
  * Fully optimized airline-specific coding:
    * Accurate domestic coding to specific gates including specific gates for smaller carriers such as Virgin Australia Regional, REX, and Air Work
    * Accurate use of domestic terminal sorting between Qantas, Qantas Link, Virgin Australia, Jetstar, and REX. 
    * International terminal gates are coded to specific operators such as ANA on gate 54, China Airlines on 30, and United on 51,53,54.
Example here.

* * *

FSLTL Notes

FSLTL users must ensure the following for "wing_span" value on the "flight_model" configuration due to the 6/12m bug in fs2020:

"72" for A320 and 737 family
"52" for CRJ/ERJ regional jets
"164" for heavy jets (777, 787, A330, A350 etc)
"223" for A380s
"131" for 767s, A300s, and 757s
No further support for FSLTL is provided since I do not use FSLTL

## About this addon

Cairns Airport (IATA: CNS, ICAO: YBCS) is an international airport in Cairns, Queensland, Australia. Formerly operated by the Cairns Port Authority, the airport was sold by the Queensland Government in December 2008 to a private consortium. It is the seventh busiest airport in Australia. The airport is located 2.3 nautical miles (4.3 km; 2.6 mi) north northwest of Cairns or 7 kilometres (4.3 mi) north of the Cairns central business district, in the suburb of Aeroglen. The airport lies between Mount Whitfield to the west and Trinity Bay to the east.

### Description

RAAF Townsville was formed on 15 October 1940 when No 24 (General Purpose) Squadron moved from RAAF Station Amberley to the new RAAF Station in Townsville. During World War II, the United States Army Air Corps (USAAC) followed by the United States Army Air Force (USAAF) was based in Townsville. 

RAAF Townsville hosts a large number of deployments throughout the year and is significant in providing support services for other Air Force operations and exercises involving all in-service aircraft types, together with a myriad of aircraft from visiting forces. RAAF Base Townsville also plays an important part in ADF operations as forward operating base for forces being deployed on operations into the South West Pacific as well as to the North.

Today, RAAF Townsville is home to more than 1,500 personnel including Air Force, Army, Defence civilians and contract staff and is one of northern Australia's primary Defence installations. RAAF Townsville is a premier forward operating base and a favourite for ADF and foreign allies.

Horn Island is  located in the Torres Strait, in Queensland, Northern Australia, between the Australian mainland and Papua New Guinea.
The island is 53 km2 (20 sq mi) in area.Horn Island is the site of Horn Island Airport, which also serves Thursday Island. Therefore, it is a gateway for travellers to the mainland and outer islands. The present-day population consists of islanders drawn from all islands of the Torres Strait, as well as non-islanders. Residents travel daily by ferry across the Ellis Channel to Thursday Island for work and school.

In Worl War II, a major Allied airbase, known as Horn Island Aerodrome, was constructed on the island and this was attacked several times by Japanese planes. It is now the island airport.

27376.body:
Australian Salt Lakes Fix - Scenery Enhancements for MSFS | Flightsim.to (https://flightsim.to/addon/27376/australian-salt-lakes-fix)
citeturn268search3 [wordlim: 200] Published: 4.6 years ago; Crawled: 2 months ago; ## https://forums.flightsimulator.com/t/water-in-dry-salt-lakes/736413 ... Jump into your favourite prop at Ayers Rock (YAYE) and head north for 10 Minutes, and you'll get to Lake Amadeus ... a veritable boating paradise! ... Anyway, this has been a bugbear of mine since my first MSFS flight back in August 2020.
They're everywhere, just have a look. Jump into your favourite prop at Ayers Rock (YAYE) and head north for 10 Minutes, and you'll get to Lake Amadeus ... a veritable boating paradise! No? Well, no! It's actually a dry salt lake. It hasn't seen standing water in living memory. The early British explorers were smoking something illicit when they called those things "Lakes" (I guess akin to Erik the Red calling that big chunk of ice a little west of Reykjavik ... Greenland!)

Anyway, this has been a bugbear of mine since my first MSFS flight back in August 2020. That was before we even had float planes! Now, I was hoping that WU7 would finally deal with this issue, but alas, it has not. So, I've just spent the better part of a day hovering around the driest continent on earth (never mind Antarctica for now) and sponged up all that excess H2O that doesn't exist in real life.

Notes:
- I've taken a fairly broad brush (or should I say big sponge). There are thousands of those buggers. If I've missed some, let me know. --------------------------------------------------------------------------------

### Description

 

#### NOTE: The dependancies listed in the dependancies section are required for both FS2020 and FS2024.

 

* * *

## FS2024 Section

V1.1   04 Dec 24

  * Stage 1 conversion to FS2024. Fixes missing buildings, corrects terrain and textures.
  * Makes the airport work fine and look fine.
  * Look out for further fixes and updates as I discover cool things in the new SDK.

 

V1.2   19 Dec 24

  * Changed the terrain pathing references for the new terrain engine to read the surfaces correctly into FS2024.
  * Other minor improvements.

 

V1.3   21 Jan 25

  * Lots of ground texture improvements that I didn't have time to do. Mainly tidying up artifacts or hiding them with trees.
  * Fixed some realy crappy looking dirt textures I never noticed.

 

V 1.5   28 Dec 25

  * FS2024 version update.
  * Replaces/substitutes many missing objects caused by SU4. Too many to list.
  * Fixes lighting issues also caused by updates in SU4.
  * All of my scenery is now being checked for this total mess they caused us Dev's.
  * Adds FS2024 Helicopter cold and dark parking.
  * Adds taxiway exit lighting from the main runways.
  * Some other minor fixes and additions.

 

* * *

## FS2020 Section

NOTE: Your sim must be up to date with all world updates installed. You do not need any photogrammetry installed,  just the base world updates as I borrow scenery from those resources. This project makes extensive use of the UK2000 Scenery Library which is free in the Marketplace. Please make sure you have it installed.

A GSX profile for this scenery by goldmund can be found here.

 

V 3.2 (3 Aug 24)

Welcome back to the all new Kalgoorlie Boulder Airport in Western Australia, now a payware quality scenery addon for you FIFO Pilots to enjoy. With almost 1000 handplaced objects, trees, fences, gates, 3D buildings and a new terminal, Kalgoorlie has truly come to life. Featuring a highly detailed apron, custom multi-layered ground textures and a true to life layout, I have put over 100 hours of work to offer an FPS optimised, low-sized-download alternative to the payware version by NZA Simulations.
  * Made some other minor corrections and improvements.
  * Removed an overlay that had made all of the ground textures look a little fake. Not sure how that got in there but it is now sorted.


* * *

Tip:

Don't forget to reload your Little Navmap scenery library now and then in order to keep your new airfields accurately portrayed within it. This way all your new taxiway designations are updated among other things.

LNM automatically searches through your community folder during the process which runs in the background so you can keep simming.

From the menu bar of LNM:  Scenery Library | Load Scenery Library | press Load. When finished, press Use Database.

 

* * *

Instructions:

Delete the previous version and then unzip and drop into your Community folder. 

 

* * *

Enjoy.

### Description

YPDN Darwin Airport Enhancement
Full reconstruction of the airport and its perimeter. All aprons and surfaces have been updated with a mixture of high-fidelity custom and Asobo materials, complete with custom decals and stencils realistic to the airport. Includes full AI support and the latest taxiway additions that are not present in the default scenery. MSFS 2024 native with an older MSFS 2020 build available.
Disclaimer: I'm not local to Darwin, so some features may not be fully correct. If you have high-quality, up-to-date references, you can DM me to help out with the project.
Version 1.06 (MSFS 2020) / 1.14 (MSFS 2024) includes:

  * Up-to-date layout (2026)
  * Custom-placed buildings and assets using Asobo Libraries
  * Custom Hi-Definition round markings and decals to match the real airport better
  * Custom objects, bollards (2024 ONLY)
  * Generic taxiway signs (MSFS 2020)
    * Custom-placed taxiway signs (2024 ONLY)
  * Generic night lighting (MSFS 2020)
    * Darwin-specific night lighting (2024 ONLY)
  * Custom terraforming around the airport perimeter
  * Aprons and runways resurfaced according to aerial imagery
    * Extra dirt and grime on surfaces (2024 ONLY)
  * Custom-made parking positions for all the important stands
  * Custom ILS, PAPI, HIRL
  * Fully custom AI routes 

Planned for future updates:

  * More custom 3D assets
  * GSX-profile (if no one decides to do one before me)

Please note that updates for MSFS 2024 are prioritized over MSFS 2020.

citeturn236search0 [wordlim: 200] Crawled: last week; So far East Timor has been a last remaining white spot on the flightsim landscape. ... Explore the newly added Dili International Airport (WPDL) in East Timor with updated runway, taxiway, and aprons.

### Description

Dili Airport, officially named Presidente Nicolau Lobato International Airport is the airport of the capital of East Timor (Timor-Leste). So far East Timor has been a last remaining white spot on the flightsim landscape. Dandy Project created the airport a while ago. Since it was mainly an update of the runway and aprons I had the wish for a complete airport.

I mainly used Microsoft assets but also other libraries to make the place come to life. Included in this airport are:

- Updated runway, taxiway and aprons

- More fitting buildings

- Helipcopter pads that can be used to spawn in

- The airport wall

- Two static aircraft and two military helicopters on the military apron

- Lots of clutter and people

- Night lighting

 

According to satellite pictures the western apron is mainly used by military helicopters. However I also added some parking spots for GA aircraft.

The main apron saw some change in the past years. It was converted from a larger number of GA parking spots to only three, that can accommodate A320/737-class aircraft.

The runway has a length of 1,850 m. There are plans to increase it to over 2,000 m in order to allow planes of the size of an A330 to land.

You may notice that there are no approach lights. That's how it is in real life.

Enjoy Dili International Airport!

GSX profile

Thanks to RW01R_Aviation, who created a GSX-file for this airport. It can be downloaded here:

Dili GSX profile

 

Installation

Unzip the file into your community folder. Other than that you need the UK 2000-library free from the marketplace as well as the libraries listed below.

On top you should have the following World Updates installed:

- Canada

- Australia

- Germany

- Caribbean

- Eastern Europe

- France

- USA

- Oceania

- Asobo Dubai airport

I tried to limit the number of libraries this time. Some of them are optional because they only account for minor items.

Dear all,

after some tests I marked the mod as compatible to Sim Update 5, because there was no reason to assume that standards could be affected negatively and because standard assets are also used in the more complex mods by edpatino (CAR\Venezuela), which he also tested and marked as compatible.

The sim update including the 2 hotfixes has partially ruined not only the simulator, numerous mods, but especially the editor: the horizon constantly rolls to the side, some objects float when placed, grouping objects - indispensable for larger projects - has become completely impossible and much more ...

This was intended as a preview of our fully featured KKIA Premium Product, but due to the man hours it takes to create these plugins, it has been extremely difficult to maintain two different versions to the same standard. KKIA or Kota Kinabalu International Airport is Malaysia’s second busiest airport after KLIA. Situated in East Malaysia on the island of Borneo, KKIA serves the city of Kota Kinabalu as well as the entire west coast of Sabah.

This add-in includes KLIA2, this terminal replaced the LCCT (Low cost carrier terminal) situated at the end of runway 32R, which I believe is now used for cargo. KLIA2 is predominately serviced by Air Asia, and their HQ building is also provided in this plug-in. The ramps in this area have been re-positioned to match the current configuration for freight.

We have also made Anjung Spotter as a seperate free download.

Please note that in this free product, previews of the Payware Edition have been included.

The following Jetways have been made operational for this version and now use our completely custom jetway models with audio and visual enhancements:
Main terminal building: B3, B10.
Satellite terminal: C6, C17.
KLIA2: K4, Q3.

We have also added our in-house developed VDGS units at the above gates for you to try out.

This preview version (1.5.0) is provided exclusively through flightsim.to
Our Payware Edition has launched and is available here.

### Description

Welcome to StaticSceneries! This is an enhancement for the payware Suvarnabhumi airport by SiamFlight. NOTE: This scenery is no longer compatible with MSFS2024.

This airport can be found here: https://secure.simmarket.com/siamflight-vtbs-suvarnabhumi-airport-thailand-msfs.phtml

This scenery uses FSLTL models to enhance the airport and make it feel more lively without running FSLTL Injector. Please note: This is a standalone enhancement; if you run FSLTL injector at the same time you will see overlapping models. In-sim traffic must be turned off (Options/General Options/Traffic/Ground Aircraft Density slider to 0).

You must have the FSLTL Base models to use this! https://fslivetrafficliveries.com/

There is no FPS loss with this whatsoever, as it only uses the models.

These models are static and will not move around. Some of the gates are unusable due to the placement of these aircraft.

HOW TO INSTALL:

Just open the downloaded folder, drop the folder within it named 'zzzSS-VTBS-StaticFSLTL' into your community folder and have a safe flight!

 

If you have any questions or requests feel free to hit me up.

### Description

Tested in MSFS2024 with BeyondATC. Built using MSFS2020.

This add-on enhances Svalbard/Longyear Airport (ICAO: ENSB), in accordance to Navigraph/Lido, and online videos.

The fixes allow BeyondATC, the FMC/FMS, and the default EFB in MSFS2024, to regcognise the airport with RW09/27, updated from RW10/28 since Sep 7, 2023 (based on Navigraph). On Google Earth, RW10/28 is visible as the satellite data was from Jul 19, 2023. Luckily, there's a video of a 737-800 landing on RW09.

Dependency:

- Wombiiactual ENxx Asset pack (for the flashing runway guard lights, and the 2 light masts at the terminal).

- VVNB - Noi Bai International Airport - Ground Base Package (for the hold-short taxi signs; might as well check out my VVNB enhancement for the package if you ever plan on visiting the airport).

Instructions:

- MSFS2024: Just extract the ZIP into Community folder, and you're ready to go.

NOTICE: iniBuilds Svalbard Longyear has been released for MSFS2024, I highly recommend it, this package will, of course, no longer be necessary.

Known issues, and limitations:

- Uneven runway surface for MSFS2020 (fixed, please install the "[Extra] Flattened RWY for MSFS2020 only" package).

- "1742m ->" sign uses "M" instead of "m", not fixable unless custom taxiway signs are to be made.

Many additions were added based on this video (wrong runway description, though): https://youtu.be/fdYUmGff8gQ?si=0D2ivkP9HAOgF6ML&t=1630

This airport complements other existing Bhutanese scenery enhancements, improving the overall regional representation.

### Description

Alpha Release! Product is not in a finished state!
Welcome to Nepal!

Tribhuvan International Airport (IATA: KTM, ICAO: VNKT, colloquially referred to as TIA) is an international airport located in Kathmandu, Nepal. The airport is named after Tribhuvan Bir Bikram Shah, the former King of Nepal. It is operating with a tabletop runway, one domestic and an international terminal. As a sole international airport, it connects Nepal to over 40 destinations in 17 countries.

The airport is a hub for two international airlines, the flag carrier Nepal Airlines and Himalaya Airlines, along with several other domestic and regional carriers. The airport is considered as a starting point for Mount Everest, with several daily flights to Lukla. Several airlines also offer Everest sightseeing flights out of Kathmandu.
What's in it?
This is an alpha version, the airport is not finished. Currently the package contains following features:
* Handcrafted buildings of the International Terminal, Tower and entrance gate and many more with optimized 4K PBR materials.
* Custom runway & taxiways  with correct naming and textures matching reality as close as possible.
* Custom aprons with textures matching reality as close as possible.
* Correct ground markings amd lines.
* Basic night lighting and correct approach lights
* Correct parking spots.
* Correct comm. frequencies
* Handcrafted model of prominent UNESCO World Heritage Boudhanath stupa that can be seen on any approach.
* Many ground objects to make airport more lively.
What's not in it (yet)?
* Handcrafted versions of the domestic terminal, military area and smaller hangars.
* Taxiway signs.
* Correct approaches and departures. (just the generic ones, which are not necessarily correct)
* Corrected ground services.
* Car park needs some love.
Many of these things will be added in future updates.

Where should I fly to?
My personal favorites are: Lukla, Pokhara, Jomsom, Jumla, Paro

Enjoy your flights around Nepal!

### Description

History:  Salalah used to be Royal Air Force base till late 60s.  It was then retuned to the host country, Oman.  It then became an International Airport.

Please, note that I have not re-designed the whole airport.  The terminal and the buildings are default.  However, I have updated the airfield to reflect correct taxiway names and signs.  I have added apron lights, gate numbers and signs, hold-short signs and Runway Ahead signs.  In addition, I have added VOR, ILS localiser and Glide slope antennas, ATC control tower and Cargo building.  It is now enjoyable to take off and land here compared to default airport.  Please enjoy it as it is free.  If you do not like it, please do not down load, Just stay with default.   

In order to install, please down load the zip file vforce-airport-oosa-salalah and drag and drop the folder into your community folder.

In order to install Amrisar Airport, download vforce-airport-viar zip file.  Unzip the file and copy the unzipped folder, vforce-airport-viar, to your community folder.

Wikipedia

Hohhot Baita International Airport (IATA: HET, ICAO: ZBHH) is an international airport serving Hohhot, the capital of Inner Mongolia, China. It is the largest airport in Inner Mongolia and lies 14.3 km (8.9 mi) east of downtown Hohhot. Its name Baita, meaning White Pagoda, derives from Wanbu Huayanjing Pagoda; one of the historical attractions in Hohhot which lies 5.6 km (3.5 mi) south-east of the airport. In 2013 it served 6,150,282 passengers.

103035.title: ZBHH - Hohhot Baita International Airport
103035.body:
ZBHH - Hohhot Baita International Airport - Airports for MSFS | Flightsim.to (https://flightsim.to/addon/103035/zbhh-hohhot-baita-international-airport)
citeturn286search3 [wordlim: 200] Published: 8 months ago; Crawled: 2 weeks ago; Hohhot Baita International Airport (IATA code: HET; ICAO code: ZBHH) is situated in Saihan District, Hohhot City, Inner Mongolia Autonomous Region, China. ... According to the Notice on Announcing the 2025 National Aeronautical Information Data Change Plan issued by the Air Traffic Management Bureau of the Civil Aviation Administration of China in January 2025, Hohhot Baita International Airport was originally scheduled to close on 27 November 2025, with all flights to be transferred to Hohhot Shengle International Airport.
However, the transfer did not occur as scheduled (as of 25 November 2025, Hohhot Shengle International Airport had completed its test flights).

Production content:

  * Hand-drawn taxiway
  * Parking position designated on the aeronautical chart
  * Semi-realistic new terminal building (source material from the internet; please contact us regarding any copyright concerns)
  * Ground and taxiway edge lines delineated based on satellite imagery
  * Repair marks on the taxiway as depicted by satellite imagery
  * Colour scheme for aprons and taxiways based on satellite imagery
  * Runway markings manually placed on the runway (which may differ from reality)
  * Asobo Default Covered Bridge (The bundled connection components may contain bugs; it is recommended to increase the Scenery LOD option to 150)
  * Automatically generated old terminal and international terminal based on MSFS
  * Modify the height of buildings in the surrounding villages
  * Manually placed hundreds of airport details (based on MSFS's built-in resources; no additional components need downloading)
  * The manually positioned emergency drill base in the eastern part of the airport
  * The control tower of the old terminal building
  * In the absence of suitable modelling, the new control tower utilises the ZGSZ tower created by Doublet. Should you not have installed it, it will not be displayed.

Current issues:

  * The new terminal lacks lighting, relying instead on manually placed apron lights (hence multiple light poles at some aprons)
  * Aprons21-32; 43-52 are designed for direct forward taxiing in reality. As this mechanism cannot be implemented in MSFS, no self-taxi guidance lines are drawn.
  * Due to terrain rendering issues, the runway elevation may be inaccurate, appearing approximately 0.5m lower than the aprons. This does not affect taxiing operations.
  * The legacy terminal requires an auto-generated terminal structure, which coexists with the auto-generated new terminal, causing clipping issues. Please avoid viewing the airport head-on!

How to install? Simply copy the two folders from the downloaded zip file into your Community folder!

Based on the latest testing, the following issues have been identified:After landing, ATC can direct you to your parking bay, but cannot direct you to the runway upon departure.

v1.1 Update Notes:

  * Fixed ILS instrument approach system (RW08 tested, RW26 should be fine)
  * Added parking bay markers (using MSFS's built-in marker tool)
  * Fixed bug causing jet bridge connections to disconnect
  * Added several airport detail enhancements

v1.2 Update Notes:

  * Fixed missing SID and STAR data in default navigation files
  * Corrected positioning errors for certain taxiways
  * Manually placed surrounding airport building details
  * Adjusted western apron colour to prevent overexposure in cockpit view
  * Added ILS Hold Short for Runway 26

v1.3 Update Notes:

  * Fixed missing RNP waypoints for SID and STAR procedures
  * Added ground support vehicle routes
  * Relocated remote stand lighting to match actual configurations
  * Manually placed surrounding airport building details

v1.4 Update Notes:

  * Modified apron colouring
  * Added ground markings for parking bays
  * Resolved issue where ATC failed to recognise taxiways

v1.5 Update Notes:

  * Fixed an error in the placement direction of the ILS signal, which now functions correctly.
  * In January 2026, Taxiway A was resurfaced from concrete to asphalt and has now been rebuilt.
  * Some minor detail enhancements have been implemented.
  * Please also note: Following this update, no further updates will be released for the next three months. Should you encounter any bugs or wish to collaborate, please leave me a message. I shall address these issues collectively in the future.

Welcome to StaticSceneries! This is an enhancement for the payware Incheon airport by LeAeroDesigns.

  * You must have the default KSEA and RJCK (Japan Update) scenery packages installed.

Installation:

Extract and place the fsfb-scenery-world-navaids folder in your community folder.

 

Acknowledgements/Credits:

  * Navigraph - for coordinate and bearing information of navaids. This mod was created using location information from Navigraph databases. It is based on AIRAC 2102. No navdata, in part or full, from Navigraph has been compiled or packaged into this mod. That being said, if this violates usage rights in any way, I will take it down if requested by Navigraph.
  * Microsoft/Asobo - for the default LOC and VOR objects.

v0.1.0 - Placed localizer antennas. Placed VOR antennas.

# World Navaids

Enhance your Microsoft Flight Simulator experience with the World Navaids mod, adding VOR and ILS antennas to default airports worldwide. Note some caveats, such as potential duplication with addon airports, and ensure default scenery packages are installed. Installation is simple - just extract the folder to your community folder and explore the skies with enhanced navaid visuals.

Those built-in instrument procedures for Hong Kong (Chek Lap Kok) Intl. Airport (VHHH) are somehow broken, or not being implemented as what they really mean. # Hong Kong (Chek Lap Kok) Intl. Airport (VHHH) NavData for Three-runway System

This add-on provides updated and enhanced instrument procedures for Hong Kong International Airport (VHHH), specifically in light of the new Three-runway System. It replaces outdated Standard Instrument Departures (SIDs) and Standard Terminal Arrival Routes (STARs) with RNAV-based alternatives, ensuring a more accurate IFR navigation experience. The package addresses issues with missing or non-functional procedures for users of the payware scenery by WFSS, introducing a selection of new SIDs, STARs, and instrument approaches. Cautions regarding altitude constraints and procedural adherence are included to ensure safe operations around the challenging Hong Kong airspace.

### Description

LOWI - Innsbruck Airport

Innsbruck Airport, also known locally as "Kranebitten Airport", is the largest international airport in Tyrol, located in the western parts of Austria. The airport, named after the city and river that it is located right up against, is located in the "Wipp Valley", surrounded by vast mountains, which makes this airport unique in every way.

Offering both challenging approaches and departures, with tight turns and limited space to manoeuvre, INN is a must-have in your community-folder, whether it be for a local VFR-flight or IFR - helicopter or airplane!

 

As Asobo's "handcrafted" version of Innsbruck was horrible, to say the least; with wrong, curved, taxiways, a bumpy runway, wrong frequencies, wrong elevation data, wrong approach-light set up, misplaced objects, buildings and ground-markings, missing spawns at parking-spots (including the helipad), with lots more to add to that list, I decided to create it myself.

I built this "enhancement" (which in reality is a completely custom remodelling of the existing airport from scratch), using some of the stock assets from Asobo's version, accompanied by some of my own assets, including custom textures from the real airport. # LOWI - Innsbruck Airport

Enhance your simulation experience with the LOWI - Innsbruck Airport add-on, which offers a comprehensive remodelling of the airport to address inaccuracies in the default version. This add-on provides correct elevation data, custom textures, realistic lighting, and meticulous attention to the airports surroundings. Included are features such as a fully operational helipad and improved parking arrangements, creating an authentic representation of one of Austrias most unique airports.

Features:

  * Highly detailed domestic and international terminals with interior modelling.
  * Highly detailed airport entrance and apron area.
  * Detailed optimized HD Textures.
  * Realistic night lighting with custom light glow for taxi signs.
  * Realistic grass coverage for the entire airport.
  * Custom modelled runway bridge for runway 12-30 crossing the adayar river.

Installation:

Just drag and drop the vomm-vomm folder into your community folder.

Known Issues:

Below are few known issues exists in the scenery that is mostly limited to the simulation.

  * Terminal building may flicker when viewed at a distance.
  * Transparent glass on the terminal may flicker when viewed very close.
  * The runway bridge on the runway 12-30 appears floating above the water, this is because of the terrain limitation in the sim, which is not placing the object on the ground when it is below the ground level.
  * Taxilight/Runway light over the bridge will illuminate the aircraft cockpit.

Update 1.1

  * Rescaled interior objects to more accurate dimensions.
  * Added ceiling light objects inside the terminal for more realistic look from apron during night time.
  * Few modelling enhancements.

Update 2.0 (Major Update)

  * Custom animated glass jetways.
  * Custom taxiway line markings.
  * Added gate numbers to the apron taxi lines.
  * Added gate stands with gate number and coordinates.
  * Added ground service with proper routes. Ground vehicles will no longer drive in runway or taxiway.
  * Added few decals to the old terminal.
  * Added animated wig-wag lights near hold short positions.
  * Added static marine traffic near the coast. (Fishing & Cargo Ships). This should enhance the overall approach to RWY25.
  * Enhancements to the harbour area.

This scenery is tested thoroughly for performance. A very special thanks to @myselfaaryan for helping me in testing the scenery. Please do let me know your comments. Also feel free to ping me anytime, if you have any questions.

Thank you for your love and support.

# VOCI/Cochin International Airport-T3 update V1.1.0 wip*

Cochin International Airport Limited [CIAL] became the first fully solar-powered airport in the world , Cochin International Airport (IATA: COK, ICAO: VOCI) is an International airport serving the city of Kochi, in the state of Kerala, India. Located at Nedumbassery, about 25 kilometres (16 mi) northeast of the city centre,It is the busiest and largest airport in the state of Kerala and 4th biggest airport in South India.[5] As of 2019, the Cochin International Airport caters to 61.8% of the total air passenger movement in Kerala.[6] It is the third busiest airport in India in terms of international traffic[7] and also ninth busiest overall. In fiscal year 2018–19, the airport handled more than 10.2 million passengers with a total of 71,871 aircraft movements.[6] The airport operates three passenger terminals and one cargo terminal with a total area of over 225,000 square metres (2,421,880 sq ft).[8] In 2015, Cochin International Airport became the world's first fully solar powered airport with the inauguration of a dedicated solar plant.[9][10] For this entrepreneurial vision, the airport won the coveted Champion of the Earth award in 2018, the highest environmental honour instituted by the United Nations.[11] The airport was awarded The Best Airport in Asia-Pacific in 2020 (5 to 15 million passengers per annum)

### Description

Dabolim Airport (IATA: GOI, ICAO: VOGO) is the sole international airport in Goa. It is operated by the Airports Authority of India as a civil enclave in an Indian Navy naval airbase named INS Hansa. The airport is located in Dabolim, 4 kilometers from the nearest city Vasco da Gama, 23 kilometers from Margao, and about 30 kilometers from the state capital Panjim.

The airport's integrated terminal was inaugurated in December 2013. In fiscal year 2017–18, the airport handled over 7.6 million passengers and 8.36 million in fiscal year 2019-20. Several European charter airlines fly to Goa seasonally, typically between November and May. Flights from the UK (London Gatwick and Manchester Airport) are operated by TUI Airways. There are also several seasonal charter flights to various Russian cities.

### Description

Welcome eveyone to the first vabb airport of msfs. Myself Abhijit Anil. This is my first ever airport work so i started with my home airport.Aviation in the Mumbai region dates back as far as 1932, when mail planes used the Juhu air strip, less than 3 miles / 2 km from the actual site of the city's airport today. In 1940, Mumbai decided to find an alternative site and a spot was chosen at Santa Cruz and Chhatrapati Shivaji Airport was born. Used by the military during the war years, Mumbai Airport was managed by the Directorate General of Civil Aviation from 1946 onwards and in 1958, a new terminal was opened.
In 1972, the operation of Mumbai's Chhatrapati Shivaji International Airport (BOM) was taken over by the International Airports Authority of India and expansion plans were soon implemented over the next three decades. By the turn of the new millennium, the airport had grown to become the busiest in the whole of India.
Both the domestic and the international terminals at Mumbai International Airport offer extensive passenger and visitor facilities. 8) All GA aircrafts have given a separate location in the airport with small hangars next to it.
9) All Cargo Plane have given a separate location in the airport with cargo hangars in front of it.

### Description

Welcome!

Thank you for checking out our scenery, many hours have been put into this project to hopefully be an accurate rendition of Riyadh's King Khaled Airport (Updated to match 2023 changes!)

King Khalid International Airport was opened in 1983 in Riyadh city. It is located in an area of 375 km2 about 35 km from the city center, consisting of five passengers’ terminals, which together serve more than 28.5​ million passengers a year.

 

There are still many aspects that are still in WIP, and will continue on building on them as I am able to, but will keep sharing the latest layout for those who are using the latest charts and/or Vatsim, so be sure to check the changelog whenever an update is available!

This scenery DOES NOT contain static aircraft at gates, the ones you see in the screenshots are AI aircraft


Installation

- Unzip the Main File, then drag and drop "banditsim-airport-oerk-riyadh" into your community folder.

GSX Users

- Grab the GSX profile from the downloads, and paste the .ini file into
Users\*username*\AppData\Roaming\virtuali\GSX\MSFS
- Disable OERK GSX jetways from the FSDT Installer/GSX Config


Features

- Realistic aprons (including taxiway layouts, parking positions, ground materials, custom decals)
- Custom 3D Modelled Buildings
  - Terminal 1-4 (International Terminals)
  - Terminal 5 (Domestic Terminal)
  - Royal Terminal
  - Control tower
  - Ground control & fire building
  - Airport mosque
- Custom 3D modelled objects
- Functional jetways
- Functional roadway/bridge between Royal Terminal, Tower & Mosque
- GSX Integration (not 100% completed)


Known Issues

- Tower, fire station and mosque are currently untextured
- Traffic drives on taxiway bridges
- Terminal 5 has multiple modelling and UV errors (will be redone, eventually)
- Many buildings are missing/not yet modelled


Footnote

If you have any suggestion, please feel free to leave a comment below
If you wish to check out the project's development and try out updates before they are updated here, kindly visit the project's GitHub page

This city pack contains original, handmade models of many Amman landmarks. Includes LODs for complex models, night lighting for all models, and PBR materials for the larger structures. 

Where a model wasn’t handmade by me, I’ve indicated this below. 

Recommended routing

The approach into OJAM (Marka Int’l) Runway 06 via the MUSAL transition gives you spectacular views over the city and takes you directly above the Roman Theater and Citadel. 

If flying from/to OJAI, I recommend installing my OJAI default scenery fix (available HERE) or purchasing MSFG’s excellent payware OJAI from SimMarket.

Syria SIM presents a major reconstruction of Damascus International Airport (OSDI) for Microsoft Flight Simulator.   * Authentic Jetway Textures: Jetway colors have been updated to realistically mimic their real-world counterparts.

### Description

Update for the wonderful Damascus Airport Scenery by HaithamElshazly. The scenery has a few issues that he promised to update but since we haven't heard from him in a while, I did it myself. Hope he is fine and will continue his work on this large and well done airport.

Things improved:

Removed apartment buildings beside the tower, half inside the terminal and further south on the airport area. There are no buildings there in reality.

Removed the three white arcs on the aiport entrance. I checked satellite pictures and they don't exist so I deleted them because they had a bug anyway. However AI-cars now show a weird behaviour in that area as they jump over it. Hope I can do something about it in the future.

Added military aircraft shelters. I know green is not the colour of the desert but for a start I didn't find a good alternative.

Replaced default static aircraft parked on aprons with somehwat nicer models. I'm not a fan of the generic pointed nose light blue A330s.

Depending on the interest in this mod I might do further updates. Please consider this just a quick remedy of the obvious problems with the original scenery, which is otherwise a great job including some beautifully handcrafted buildings. Enjoy the airport!

Installation

Unzip the file into your community folder along with the original Damascus scenery.

Make sure you install the dependencies as listed below.

Also have the Japan World Update installed as well as the free UK2000-library from the Marketplace if you want to see two military C-17.

### Description

2024-users, this was developed in 2020. I marked it compatible with 2024 since one user wrote me, he uses it in 24. Please contact me, if this is not the case for you or if you find issues. I'll be happy to work on them. Thank you!

Scenery Update for Shota Rustaveli Tbilisi International Airport by AmSim. Tblisi, in some countries also known as Tiflis is the captial city of Georgia (former Sovjet Union). The scenery by Amsim depicts the airport rather beautifully but there is some detail missing as well as the cargo area that needs fixing because of a badly placed and untextured building.

 

What you get in this package:

  * A corrected cargo area
  * Reworked fuel depot plus two more added
  * Car shelters with solar cells and more cars in front of the terminal
  * The military apron with static helicopters, aircraft, trucks, clutter and starting points for helicopters
  * Terraforming
  * Airports light poles with proper night lighting all over the place
  * Runway guard lights
  * Runway and taxiway signs
  * Added parking near terminal including fence
  * Added missing buildings in the airport perimeter like the VOR, checkerboard buildings, fuel depots
  * Removed static 747
  * Added conveyance area
  * etc. etc.

HomyA320 created a GSX-profile for Tbilisi. A big shoutout to him! You find his work here:

AmSim Tbilisi GSX Profile

 

Installation

Unzip this file into your community folder. Most objects are Asobo default. Make sure you have all world updates installed.

This fix works 'on top' of the AmSim scenery so you need to activate both at a time. This mod does not change any of the original AmSim files!

The AmSim-scenery is available on the 2020 MSFS marketplace only.

Aprons, parkings, taxiways and taxi signs, markings updated according to current charts and satellite images for the needs of Vatsim and Ivao Members.

citeturn338search3 [wordlim: 200] Published: 5.3 years ago; Crawled: 3 weeks ago; The mosque is located immediately west of Al'Rifa'i (a default MSFS POI) and can be seen clearly on any of the 05 runway approaches to Cairo International Airport (HECA).
Constructed in 879AD and designed by a Christian Orthodox architect, the Mosque of Ibn Tulun is one of the oldest treaures of the Islamic World. It is distinctive for it's wide, open courtyard and spiral staircase minaret. After more than 1000 years, it now finds itself engulfed on all sides by the sprawling metropolis of modern Cairo. The mosque is located immediately west of Al'Rifa'i (a default MSFS POI) and can be seen clearly on any of the 05 runway approaches to Cairo International Airport (HECA).

This scenery for MSFS includes my hand-made model for Ibn Tulun Mosque (using Blender 2.9). I have made some simplifications to the architecture to aide construction. Also, the scenery does not yet include night lighting, but I am working on that.

INSTALLATION: Simply drag and drop the folder in teh zip file to your Community folder, delete to uninstall! :-)

This model is freeware and is supplied as is (I make no guarantees or warranty). Please do not redistribute without permission. This model uses some textures obtained under freeware license from https://www.textures.com

6102.body:
The Citadel, Cairo, Egypt - Scenery Enhancements for MSFS | Flightsim.to (https://flightsim.to/addon/6102/muhammed-ali-mosque-cairo-egy)
citeturn338search8 [wordlim: 200] Published: 5.6 years ago; Crawled: 2 weeks ago; The entire complex is a UNESCO world heritage site and can be seen on final approach to Cairo International Airport (HECA) runways 05L, C and R and is a prominent VFR marker. ... Witness the iconic Muhammed Ali Mosque and Al-Nasir Muhammed Mosque on your flight. ... Here, then are the notes: -Added Al-Nasir Muhammed Mosque, which is right next door to Muhammed Ali Mosque on the Citadel site. -Changed the POI marker to “The Citadel” (rather than have individual POI markers for each building, which becomes extremely cluttered in the sim view). -Updated night lighting for both buildings. -Minor refinements to size and placement of Muhammed Ali Mosque. -Updated file title, description and screenshots on flightsim.to page to reflect change in focus of the scenery project.

### Description

This is my hand-made scenery and night lighting for the Cairo Citadel using models I have created in Blender 2.9. 
 

The Cairo Citadel is a medieval Islamic fortress located in the heart of Cairo, Egypt. Dating from the 12 th Century, it has long served as a seat of cultural, political and military power for the Islamic rulers of Egypt. From it’s elevated position in the Muqattam Hills, the site enjoys commanding views across modern day Cairo from the heart of the city, with a clear line of site to the River Nile in the West and the Great Pyramids of Giza beyond. The entire complex is a UNESCO world heritage site and can be seen on final approach to Cairo International Airport (HECA) runways 05L, C and R and is a prominent VFR marker. It is located approximately 15km SW from runway 05C threshold and immediately to the SE of Al-Rifa'i Mosque (which is already a default MSFS POI). 

The fortress is home to two of Cairo’s most important mosques: 

Muhammed Ali Mosque: one of the most famous landmarks in Cairo, this 19 th Century mosque was built by Egypt’s Ottoman rulers. --------------------------------------------------------------------------------

### Description

Juba Airport is one of the few international airports in South Sudan. The airport is not in good conditions, while all the radio navaids are inoperable IRL, painted lines faded severely, and aircraft are parked arbitrarily, including abandoned aircraft. There is a "new" terminal being built in 2009 according to Wikipedia but left unfinished and abandoned due to lack of funds. A "real" new terminal is completed in 2019, which is much smaller than the abandoned one.

With this addon, all the taxiways have been remade according to aerodrome chart, the "real" terminal is crafted and the ILS for Runway 13 has been "resurrected". Just choose VOR 13 approach (the approach procedure is very similar with the ILS approach at the past) and enter the ident or frequency manually (IJC / 108.7) then you will be OK. There are only a few of explicitly defined parking bays, but you can just park the aircraft anywhere on the apron you want, like the real case.

To-dos: ATC tower (both the old and new one)

### Description

FJDG, Diego Garcia Air/Naval Base
Created by: TangoFox

Based upon the idea and request of “JohnG,” I’m pleased to offer to the community a revamped Diego Garcia Airport for an ultimate military airport experience.

Diego Garcia is a joint US/UK military base, although it mainly hosts US naval and air forces.

 

Considering its secretive military nature, it wasn’t easy to get detailed references of the airport other than scattered satellite and random old images on Google, most of which “JohnG” thankfully provided.

Therefore, I tried to replicate the airport vicinity as much as possible, noticing that it is dynamic, and what you see today on the satellite might not be there the next day. 

* * *

Third-party Contents:
This customized airport contains third-party static models that are permitted for personal free use only, including games. Any commercial re-use therefore is strictly prohibited without the consent of the original copyright holder.

* * *

Installation:
1. Unzip the downloaded file.
2. Drag and drop the unzipped folder into the game "Community" folder.
For example, this is the path of Microsoft Store installation:
C:\Users\name\AppData\Local\Packages\Microsoft.FlightSimulator_8wekyb3d8bbwe\LocalCache\Packages\Community\

For any future updates: 
First remove/delete the old folder and replace it with the new one.

### Description

About the project

After nine months of work, my depiction of Ivato Int'l Airport in Madagascar is finally finished. It took much longer than originally expected. I had to realize that a project of this size is still too big for me. Basically I am satisfied, but there are some points I would have liked to improve, especially the ground textures. 
But never mind. Now it's finished. I hope you like it anyway. Have fun! 

 

About Ivato Int'l Airport

Ivato Int'l Airport is the airport in the capital of Madagascar, Antananarivo. It is located on the northern edge of the city. In order to meet international standards, the airport received a state-of-the-art new terminal a few years ago. However, the old one remains in operation. 
Among other things, Madagascar Airlines offers flights from here to destinations all over the world. General aviation is also well represented at this airport. 

 

Main features

  * Custom 3d buildings & objects
  * Custom ground textures
  * Custom night lighting
  * Added parking positions
  * Accurate vegetation & terraforming
  * And much more...

 

Installation

  * Download the ZIP-file from Flightsim.to.
  * Open the ZIP-file. You will find a folder named "nfm-ivato-fmmi".
  * Drag-and-drop this folder into your MSFS community folder. 
  * Start MSFS. The add-on should work now.

 

Other things

Created using assets from ambientCG.com(CC0).

If you enjoy this freeware add-on and want to help me finance my pilot training a little bit, I would appreciate a small donation via PayPal a lot :)

Have fun!

### Description

Located 9.5 Kilometers (Km) from the city of Beira, in the province of Sofala, Beira International Airport is the second largest air terminal in Mozambique. Its importance as an entry and exit route and a fundamental part of the national air infrastructure is undeniable, as it offers domestic and international flights to destinations in Africa, Europe and the Middle East. In addition, the airport has vast potential to boost tourism and business in the central region of the country.

With a runway measuring 2,400 meters long and 45 meters wide, Beira International Airport has the capacity to receive large aircraft, such as the Boeing 747 and Airbus A340.

Since i love flying some domestic flight around my country "Mozambique", i was not happy how the default aiport looked like in the sim, so i did some fixes to the airport to make it look more like the one in real life.

By default this airport doesn't have a pushback tug, so i didn't include it. Due to some limitations in msfs sdk, i couldn't add a baggage loader cart without adding the pushback tug service, so i recommend using third party addons such as ground service x etc.

If you would like to support my work, email me: Victorjosemassingue2@gmail.com

Installation:
=============
Simply extract the file and copy the included folder into your Community folder. (If you are updating this scenery to a newer version, first delete the existing folders of the same name).

Enjoy your flight!

Nestled in the heart of southern Democratic Republic of Congo, Lubumbashi International Airport (FZQA) is your entry point to the vibrant city of Lubumbashi, the economic capital of the Haut-Katanga Province. Known as the Copper Capital, Lubumbashi is a bustling hub for mining, trade, and culture, with its rich reserves of copper and cobalt driving global industries.

Lubumbashi is more than just a mining center—it’s a city steeped in history and brimming with opportunity. As one of the largest cities in the DRC, it boasts a thriving business environment, a dynamic cultural scene, and warm, welcoming people. Lubumbashi International Airport is a vital link for both domestic and international travel. With its modern facilities and strategic location, FZQA connects the Haut-Katanga Province to major African cities like Johannesburg, Nairobi, and Dar Es Salaam, as well as to the world beyond.

### Description

Replacement for the old dirt strip of Namibe, Angola (which is amids the houses of this coastal town and long closed) with the new FNMO "Welwitschia mirabilis" (named after a famous plant growing in the Namib desert) airport having a 8200 ft asphalt runway, approach, runway and taxiway lighting. The new airport was constructed a military base during the Angolan civil war, and was made fit for touristic purposes. It is situated in the semidesert some 3 miles S of the old one, and serves domestic flights. The VOR VMO (114.1 MHz) and DME MO (358 kHz) serves as radio aid for semi precision approaches.

Caution: As the ICAO remains the same, and there is no way to change the location of the airport symbol in MSFS (may be a bug?), the symbol on the ingame world map as well as in the GPS will still be shown at the old, wrong place. However, the runway will be shown at the correct place in the GPS, and also in the detail view of the world map. So, when selecting "zoom to details" the airport seemingly disappears, but you see the actual runway and the parking spots!
Installation: copy the package into your Community folder.

THE SCENERY IS NOW OFFICIALLY COMPATIBLE WITH MSFS 2024!

Features:

  * close to real life taxiway layout and markings created with reference to the newest satellite imagery
  * close to real life ground textures created with reference to the newest satellite imagery
  * all gates on the international and domestic terminals have been newly placed (some may be a bit misaligned, if so, please let me know) and freed from the static aircraft, so they are usable for Vatsim
  * removed the static jetways and replaced them with the standard MSFS ones, so they are usable
  * newly added approach and center line lighting on runway 18L, which was missing in the original scenery
  * added taxiway edge lights to taxiway B
  * details like ILS antennas and construction site for the expansion of the cargo apron

A GSX-Profile is now also included. It is still in development, so if you see any bugs, please tell me.

It features custom pushback and custom parking positions.

KNOWN ISSUES:

The parking stands were aligned with the PMDG 737. That means the gates for the heavy planes are misaligned. This will hopefully be fixed soon.
Some cars are standing on the roads at the moment, which doesnt look really good.

ToDo-List:

  * further work on the ground textures and markings
  * add the GA aprons
  * terraforming (especially the western part on taxiway F leading up to the terminal, which is very steep)

# Banjul International Airport - GBYD (Gambia)

Banjul International Airport (GBYD), the main airport of Gambia, is represented in this detailed scenery add-on designed for Microsoft Flight Simulator. Featuring custom 3D models, realistic night lighting, and animated elements including people and animals, the scenery enhances the virtual flying experience. Built during World War II, this airport serves as the nations only commercial hub. The add-on requires several additional libraries for full functionality and has not yet been tested in MSFS2024.
