### Description

Amílcar Cabral International Airport (IATA: SID, ICAO: GVAC), also known as Sal International Airport, is the main international airport of Cape Verde. The airport is named after the revolutionary leader Amílcar Cabral. It is located two km west-southwest from Espargos on Sal Island. Sal is the main hub for the national airline, Cabo Verde Airlines; and serves as a base for carrier Cabo Verde Express. This airport was also one of NASA's locations for a facility to handle the Space Shuttle after reentering from orbit.

Please note that this scenery don't reflect the real buildings and environment of GVAC Airport, it's only a free creation to bring more beauty for standard MSFS airport.

I have added also night light.

This scenery uses only standard Asobo libraries, no additional downloads are required. 

To install, please only copy "vedras-airport-gvac-sal.rar" file to your Commmunity folder. 

Please note that I can use different Asobo/MSFS libraries to build my own sceneries, including new libraries from World Updates. Then, if you don't have all World Updates installed on your MSFS, it's possible that you don't see all buildings and other objects from my scenery. It will depend of what objects I have used on each scenery and what World Updates you have or not.

LEPA Palma de Mallorca Airport - What´s included?

This version of Palmas Son Sant Joan airport includes custom 3d models for all terminals, custom modeled and textured jetways, some hangars, the tower and VOR/ILS antennas as well as custom ground markings and textures, taxiway signage, lighting and parking spaces. All terminals (excluded main building and tower) also include a night-lit interior visible from the in- and outside! This is a work-in-progress scenery of Geneva Airport (LSGG) for Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024.

The goal of this project is to progressively recreate Geneva Airport with improved accuracy, details, and immersion compared to the default scenery. The airport is currently under active development, and many areas are still being worked on.

Current features:

  * Custom airport layout for LSGG
  * Initial improvements to runways, taxiways, and apron areas
  * Ongoing adjustments for realism and accuracy

Important notes:

⚠️ This scenery is not finished yet ⚠️

Expect visual issues, missing details, or inaccuracies
Regular updates will be released over time as development continues
I am actively working on this project and plan to continuously improve and expand the scenery, adding more details, fixes, and optimizations in future updates.

I am happy to present to community enhancement for FlyTampa's Athens Eleftherios Venizelos (LGAV).

NOTAM

This enhancement pack does not change nor modify the original scenery in any way. It only adds a lot of stuff to make it even better.

 

Things added:

- Airport illumination as well as extensive work on area illumination (car parks, highway of Attiki Odos, service roads etc)

- Two missing light masts at helicopter apron added

- Hazard lights to airport's tall objects and masts

- Hazard lights to airport's wind barriers

- Long stay car park illuminated and populated

- Lamps and illumination to roads

- Airport clutter especially at remote stands and satelite terminal

- If you see a problem, if something's not working, DO LET ME KNOW either in comments section of via private message. I can't fix the problem if I don't know about its existence. I have different files for myself and different files prepared for you guys (no static aircrafts, less elements to limit number of libraries needed etc) so might happen I don't use what I publish, not in direct form.

If you're seeing something weird, but you're not using this enhancement with the airport it's designed for, don't report it.

- Follow the file. It's not for me, but for you. If the file is corrupt for some reason, or causes CTD, IT WILL be updated. If you don't follow the file, you will miss the updates and might be stuck with either incomplete or corrupt version.

 

For those, who use drag and drop - drop into community folder together with the airport main file

### Description

Belgrade Nikola Tesla Airport (Serbian: Аеродром Никола Тесла Београд / Aerodrom Nikola Tesla Beograd) or Belgrade Airport (Serbian: Аеродром Београд / Aerodrom Beograd) (IATA: BEG, ICAO: LYBE) is an international airport serving Belgrade, Serbia. It is the largest and the busiest airport in Serbia, situated 18 km (11 mi) west of downtown Belgrade.

This scenery ADDS NEW RUNWAY 12R and improves old runway 12L to the existing LYBE scenery created by Danilo081. This scenery also adds new control tower, new model of an old control tower, apron C extension, additional parking spots, gates, ramps, adds new taxiways to match the real life airport as well as adds all BRAND NEW SID, STAR, APPROACH procedures for both runways. It also corrects the old ILS, adds new ILS, corrects old runway width, and it's approach lights. Currently this addon can work as standalone but in order to have best experience please download existing LYBE scenery by Danilo81 below.

In order to use this addon propery you need to do the following:

1. download latest version of LYBE made by Danilo81 and his team here: https://flightsim.to/file/41863/airport-nikola-tesla-belgrade-aerodrom-nikola-tesla-beograd

2. follow their instructions to properly install everything

3. download this LYBE-Nikola Tesla-2 runways addon zip file and unpack the entire content to your community folder. (ALL the files that are included in our zip file). MAKE SURE TO DELETE OUR PREVIOUS VERSION. DO NOT JUST OVERWRITE.

4. enjoy flying!

NOTE: if you already have our previous version, please delete the old one before updating! If you have any problem please join us at our FS2020 Srbija discord and we will help you with the instalation. https://discord.gg/BN5h9mhpxK

Please note: this is a temporary addon, and over time we will be modeling all the latest real life buildings and adding them to this new scenery so please follow and subscribe as there's much more to come in the following weeks/months. Addon contains brand new SID, STAR, APPROACH procedures matching the latest AIP publications. 】

### Description

Baneasa (Aurel Vlaicu) International Airport is situated 8 km North of city center of Bucharest, Romania, ICAO code LRBS.

Baneasa Airport is among the five oldest airport in the world, the first flights being in 1909. The current terminal was opened in 1952 representing a 3 blades propeller.

Hand crafted terminal, hangars and the aprons (markings, taxiways...)

Installation

Extract the “luciancristea-lrop” folder from the zip file to your Microsoft Flight Simulator “Community” folder.

Depending of your MSFS installation, you may find the “Community” folder:

Microsoft Store edition AND/OR Gamepass edition:

C:\Users\[YOUR USERNAME]\AppData\Local\Packages\Microsoft.FlightSimulator_\LocalCache\Packages\Community

Steam edition:

C:\Users\[YOUR USERNAME]\AppData\Roaming\Microsoft Flight Simulator\Packages\Community

### Description

I'm happy to present enhancement pack for Amsim's Minsk National a.k.a. Minsk-2 Airport, Belarus. 

NOTAM

This enhancement pack does not change nor modify the original scenery in any way. It only adds a lot of stuff to make it even better.

NOTAM #2

To all haters who flood the internet and, unfortunately, this website as well - Yes, this is enhancement to a Belarusian airport, no I don't give a damn about your oppinions about Belarusia nor Russia and its citizens, so keep your twisted unhappy excrements to yourself. This is a community of nearly a million users, most of whom are here to enjoy the world of flight simulation, not to discuss politics. You are free to make comments regarding enhancement, regardless of whether you like it or not. Make a comment about politics and you will be reported.

Things added:

- As always, airport illumination, so it's not dark anymore

- Tower illumination (red and ocean blue or whatever it's called)

- Few buildings missing around airport

- Few ILS antennae that were missing

- Hazard lights to airport masts and antennae (not all as some don't seem to have hazard lights as far as I could see on recordings and photos)

- Airport clutter (Belarusians do seem to be very neat nation, there's very little clutter around airport in the first place, all seems to be stowed away, so most of clutter you see here is my imagination so the airport does not look like it's dead)

- Airport car park illumination

- Runway guard lights

 

Most objects this time come from default MSFS SDK libraries, but a few additional are needed:

- ALL world updates and relevant airports, especially Germany

- https://flightsim.to/file/2605/we-love-vfr-region-1

- https://flightsim.to/file/23692/superspud-airport-asset-library

- https://flightsim.to/file/1923/mikea-at-assetpack

- UK2000 library (available via marketplace as freeware)

- EDHK Lights & Objects Developers Pack (Asset-Pack) - https://flightsim.to/file/2549/edhk-lights-pack

- https://flightsim.to/file/16007/msfs-object-library-with-150-models-ranging-from-towers-hangers-terminals-to-cones

- UK2000 library (available via marketplace as freeware)

- https://flightsim.to/addon/88101/library-of-automotive-equipment-and-objects-for-msfs2020

- https://flightsim.to/addon/1923/mikea-at-assetpack

- https://flightsim.to/addon/46314/ethnicfs-train-kit-library

- https://flightsim.to/file/5452/dave-s-3d-people-library (that can also be found here). If you're having any problems finding this one send me private message)

- https://flightsim.to/addon/6072/sdr-scenery-pack-v1-0

- https://flightsim.to/addon/30645/usdb-bovanenkovo-airport

- Aerosoft's EDLP paderborn (freeware available via Aerosoft One app)

 

Two versions included - For those who wish to have static aircrafts and those, who wish to have no static aircrafts.

 

A PLEA

- If you see a problem, if something's not working, DO LET ME KNOW either in comments section of via private message. I can't fix the problem if I don't know about its existence.

If you're seeing something weird, but you're not using this enhancement with the airport it's designed for, don't report it.

- Follow the file. It's not for me, but for you. If the file is corrupt for some reason, or causes CTD, IT WILL be updated. If you don't follow the file, you will miss the updates and might be stuck with either incomplete or corrupt version.

 

For those, who use drag and drop - drop into community folder together with the airport main file

For those who use Addon Linker - have enhancement pack file active as well as the airport files

Tromsø Scenery Pack (ENTC)

This package contains several landmarks in the area around Tromsø Airport. One of the main landmarks included are Sandnessundet Bridge which is located just only 0,5 km west of Tromsø Airport (ENTC). This bridge can be seen when approacing Tromsø Airport from north and south. I have also included all maritime navigation aids from Kvalsundet north west of Tromsø, Grøtsundet north east of Tromsø, Ryøya south west of Tromsø and Ramfjorden sout east of Tromsø. Version 1.2:

  * Added the weather radar station on top of the mountain Stor Kjølen that can be found 7,6 km NW of Tromsø Airport (ENTC).

  * Scenery should now be compatible with MM Simulations ENTC airport. My bridge will now be displayed alone instead of two bridges showing at the same time.
  * NB! If two bridges still shows, start the sim and go to "General Options" -> "Developers". Turn "Developer mode" to ON. Then go to the Tools menu bar on top of the screen and choose "Scenery Package Order". Find "sauron-scenery-entc" and click on the down arrow until it is below "mmsimulations-airport-entc-tromso". Restart the sim.

Known Issues:

  * Red collision lights on top of bridge will not show/light up until very close distance.
  * Have not optimized the bridge and other objects with LOD-models.

Installation:

  * Make sure to delete earlier versions if installed. Then, just unpack .zip file and drag scenery folder into the community folder.

Welcome to Oslo Gardermoen airport (ENGM), the largest airport in Norway!

INSTALLATION INSTRUCTIONS:
-Drop the base package 'engm-oslo' folder always to your simulator's Community folder.

-'engm-ultra-interior-optional' is an optional extra package that includes enhanced terminal interior elements. 
If you want to use it, drop 'engm-ultra-interior-optional' folder also to your simulator's Community folder.

The scenery will look good even without the optional extra package. The extra package might have
a small performance hit. 
The 'engm-ultra-interior-optional' package adds: 

-Static 3D passenger models inside the terminal. IF YOU WANT TO USE THESE PASSENGER MODELS, YOU NEED TO INSTALL 'DAVE'S 3D PEOPLE LIBRARY' FROM FLIGHTSIM.TO "https://flightsim.to/file/5452/dave-s-3d-people-library" TO MAKE THE PASSENGER MODELS APPEAR. (If you don't want to use them, then no need to install it.)
-Departure hall interior (check-in, baggage drop, security check)
-Desks and ticket checks at gates
-Shops, tax free etc. for the middle part of the terminal
-Added details for Domestic transfer area, Domestic/International transition area, Passport control area

Updating: Remove the previous versions from your Community folder before installing the new version.

GSX addon users: The scenery should work fine with GSX. If you want to use my custom jetways instead of the generic GSX jetways, be sure to disable those GSX jetways in this scenery.

Current features:

  * -Current layout of the airport (10/2023)
  * -Custom models of the whole main terminal, ATC tower, ENGM specific custom objects i.e. lamp posts, wigwag lights, VDGS (non-operational) at gates, blue and orange taxiway lights at blue and orange lines. Custom buildings at cargo apron, Norwegian and SAS technical hangars, white ground radars, east side buildings/hangars. Custom buildings for GA area and hangars around de-icing areas.
  * -Detailed interior modelling of the terminal
  * -Custom night lighting
  * -Extensive amount of ground markings
  * -Custom runway markings
  * -Custom fully working jetways

The airport has not been tested without both Nordic World Updates installed!

Feel free to give feedback, report bugs, share images of parts of the airport etc. I try to improve the airport as well as I can. 

You can also find me on Discord with the name hergi1234#8637

Hey everybody, this is my first release for MSFS20.

It's the Christophorus 12 HQ, located on the Graz LOWG airport next to the capital city of styria, in southern Austria.

I was working on the Zeltweg LOXZ Airbase already but as soon as this awesome H135 helicopter mod dropped, I had to pause that project and start making this HQ which is just about 30km away from my hometown. ### Description

I am happy to present to the community, yet another enhancement pack, this time for SimWings' Munich J.Strauss Airport (EDDM). The airport is done nicely, but in my oppinion it was nice as long as the sun did not set. Night time Munich was...

...required few improvements.

NOTAM

This enhancement pack does not change nor modify the original scenery in any way. It only adds a lot of stuff to make it even better.

NOTAM #2

This airport can be improved further by adding Christmas decorations found here

Things added:

- Illumination (Soooo much needed) to airport, stands, local industrial areas, train station, local roads, terminal roads

- Clutter so the airport does not look like it's deserted

- Lamps missing at stand 155 and 135

- White beacon to Tower as in real life

- Hazard lights to nearby structures

As always, to enjoy the enhancement fully you need to download additional libraries:

- ALL world updates especially Germany with relevant airports (esp.EDJA and EDVK)

- We Love VFR Region1 https://flightsim.to/file/2605/we-love-vfr-region-1

- Follow the file. It's not for me, but for you. If the file is corrupt for some reason, or causes CTD, IT WILL be updated. If you don't follow the file, you will miss the updates and might be stuck with either incomplete or corrupt version.

For those, who use drag and drop - drop into community folder together with the airport main file

For those who use Addon Linker - have enhancement pack file active as well as the airport files

# Enhancement for SimWings' Munich J.Strauss Airport (EDDM)

This enhancement pack is designed for SimWings Munich J. Strauss Airport (EDDM), focusing on improving the airports nighttime aesthetics and overall realism. It introduces significant illumination enhancements, additional clutter to create a more vibrant atmosphere, and essential details like hazard lights and beacons. The add-on does not alter the original scenery but enriches it with various enhancements while requiring additional libraries for full functionality.
